species.name: Abyss
species.flavor: The Abyss is said to have power to raise the dead. No one knows where it came from, or where it's going.

species.name: Antlan
species.flavor: A hot-blooded monster with golden pincers as its special feature. It has a big heart in its small body!

species.name: Anyamu
species.flavor: The mascot of ''Monster Farm Lagoon''. It can only be revived from a disc available at an event.

species.name: Antero
species.flavor: It looks like a large deer. It primarily learns and excels at [[intelligence]]-based techniques of each element. Its effectiveness varies greatly depending on the enemy's element, but when the matchup is favorable, it possesses overwhelming power.

species.name: Arrow Head
species.flavor: Since it has a very hard shell, it is hardly KO'd in battle.

species.name: Ape
species.flavor: You'll need a lot of patience to raise this monster.

species.name: Ark
species.flavor: A small animal monster that has acquired the ability to change shape over centuries. In battles, it transforms into its ideal form, but perhaps because of its serious longing to look cool, many of its [[:Category:Techniques|Techniques]] are pretentious.

species.name: Baku
species.flavor: It doesn't like trouble, and it is an innocent monster.

species.name: Bajarl
species.flavor: It is naughty. When someone scolds it, it hides in a pot.

species.name: Beaclon
species.flavor: It has a strong body and much [[power]]. However, its [[Intelligence|I.Q]]. is low.

species.name: Centaur
species.flavor: This monster is [[Intelligence|intelligent]], just and proud.

species.name: Chuparo
species.flavor: It possesses a bird-like loveliness. This monster starts out shy, but once it trusts you it will never betray that trust. Its fluffiness is getting more and more popular!

species.name: Color Pandora
species.flavor: This monster has three wills: victory, love, and effort.

species.name: Dolan
species.flavor: A monster characterized by its blue body and tiger-striped clothing. For some reason, it unilaterally considers [[Mocchi]]] its rival. It's good at attacks that involve discharging electricity and head-butting, and it seems that its name (Doran) comes from the thunder god Indra, even though everyone gossips that it actually comes from the

species.name: Disk
species.flavor: Until recently, nobody knew that this CD was a monster.

species.name: Doodle
species.flavor: Only known to a few people. He's absolutely a mystery.

species.name: Dino
species.flavor: Average in all abilities, he needs a good breeder's hand.

species.name: Dragon
species.flavor: A very rare and popular one. Be careful; he could die young.

species.name: Ducken
species.flavor: This toy-like monster is an artifact of the ancient era.

species.name: Durahan
species.flavor: Ancient armor has mutated into the monster with this name.

species.name: Falco
species.flavor: Falco is a gentle, yet powerful monster with a passion for peace and justice. The younger crowd looks up to it for its bold character.

species.name: Garu
species.flavor: A mischievous monster with an insatiable curiosity. Always energetic and jumping around, its lively presence seems to make others feel more energetic, too.

species.name: Gali
species.flavor: Considered as a god who's taken on a monster's appearance.

species.name: Gaboo
species.flavor: Contrary to its scary appearance, it is earnest and shy.

species.name: Gitan
species.flavor: Gently floating along with its big ears and big tail, this monster looks very mysterious. I wonder why its eyes are always so sullen...

species.name: Ghost
species.flavor: He captures the soul of the breeder's last monster.

species.name: Globsto
species.flavor: Its appearance is similar to the enemy monster [[Shierure]]. It learns many [[Guts]]-draining techniques.

species.name: Golem
species.flavor: His solid rock body helps him have a lot of [[Power]]. Slow.

species.name: Henger
species.flavor: A hybrid who's made from the souls of the other monsters.

species.name: Hare
species.flavor: Despite a small stature, he has good, strong [[Power]].

species.name: Hopper
species.flavor: It is a naughty monster, but it is loved by many trainers.

species.name: Jell
species.flavor: His dense body can absorb the damage of an opponent.

species.name: Illumine
species.flavor: They live in quiet places where moonlight is visible. Because they are good at moving through shadows, they are highly valued as bodyguards.

species.name: Joker
species.flavor: This monster was so atrocious that it was once sealed up.

species.name: Jill
species.flavor: This legendary monster can be found in the snow mountains.

species.name: Kato
species.flavor: It looks like an old cat, and loves to drink olive oil.

species.name: Korunu
species.flavor: A close-combat type monster. It overwhelms opponents with its high [[Power|strength]] and [[Defense|durability]]. It learns intelligence-based techniques of each element, but these are more difficult to use than its strength-based techniques.

species.name: Kikimo
species.flavor: Kikimo primarily learns fire-elemental techniques, while Kokono primarily learns earth-elemental techniques. They excel at mid-to-long-range combat. On the other hand, they are helpless if an enemy gets too close. They also learn unique techniques that can lower the enemy's ability or negate the opponent's resistance effects.

species.name: Kawazumo
species.flavor: Captivated by a traditional sport from a faraway land, it trains tirelessly. Just when you think it's about to engage in an honorable match, it suddenly hurls a bomb at you.

species.name: Lamour
species.flavor: With its large, [[Strawberry (Item)|strawberry]]-like ears wobbling on its head, Lamour is said to be able to make everyone who sees it feel happy. It is the number one most popular monster among women.

species.name: Madillo
species.flavor: A monster of very few words, it trains hard in silence. It'd like to do something better with its life but it doesn't know how. It trains hard in silence again today.

species.name: Lesione
species.flavor: This is a spoiled baby monster whose cry for its mother caused it to become a Lesihorne. Other Lesiones start crying when they hear it cry.

species.name: Magic
species.flavor: An elusive and shy monster who's always in disguise.

species.name: Maya
species.flavor: A flexible monster with a glowing aura on its wings. When its angry, it spreads its wing of aura wide to get into a battle. Its posture with wings wide open is beautiful, but cold appearance.

species.name: Mamou
species.flavor: A monster with a massive, mammoth-like body. As its appearance suggests, it is very sturdy, and it excels at physical attacks that utilize its size. An update changed its motion, allowing it to handle mid-range and long-range attacks (Its mid-range attacks, in particular, have a decent attack speed). Its close-to-mid-range attacks are earth-elemental and its mid-to-long-range attacks are ice-elemental.

species.name: Mew
species.flavor: Bears a strong resemblance to a cat-like doll figure.

species.name: Metalner
species.flavor: It is considered to have come from a planet far from here.

species.name: Mocchi
species.flavor: Its sticky skin and cute movements attract a lot of trainers.

species.name: Mogi
species.flavor: It uses the big drill on its head to dig through the ground on a 16-beat rhythm. It's kind of like a [[mole]].

species.name: Mock
species.flavor: This tree-like monster has a crooked character.

species.name: Monol
species.flavor: He has a very special way of reducing foe's [[damage]].

species.name: Momo
species.flavor: Momo likes to be calm and move at its own pace. It always carries that large walnut for its aroma-therapeutic effects.

species.name: Naga
species.flavor: Most violent of the monsters. He lives for battles.

species.name: Niton
species.flavor: When something surprises it, it hides in its shell quickly.

species.name: Ogyo
species.flavor: This magnificent maiden is the most elegant of them all. Because of its great pride, you must be careful how you treat it.

species.name: Octopee
species.flavor: Octopee is usually very docile, but once it gets upset, it won't stop. When you see its eyes change, RUN!

species.name: Pancho
species.flavor: A huge pumpkin-turned-monster. Like a hermit crab, the shell doesn't grow, so a new one has to be found periodically. That's why it makes such a mess.

species.name: Pixie
species.flavor: A popular one who's selfish and hard to breed.

species.name: Phoenix
species.flavor: This is a legendary monster that never gives up.

species.name: Piroro
species.flavor: It looks like an eye that floats inside a mouth. The mysteriousness is somewhat cute. A clown-like monster who uses its body freely to do many performances.

species.name: Psiroller
species.flavor: This monster was recently discovered, and many things are still unknown. Is it just a rhino, or is the roller alive too? It's still often debated.

species.name: Plant
species.flavor: A very quiet fellow who's quite popular among all.

species.name: Raiden
species.flavor: This monster never misses daily training. It does not bother with small things, thinking only about ways to become stronger.

species.name: Ripper
species.flavor: A speedy monster that can control wind and ice at will. The sharp sickles it has on it's elbows can slice whole rocks in two.

species.name: Salamander
species.flavor: Specializes in fire-element attacks. Normally has a cute cry, but when it breathes fire, it makes a terrifying sound. Its third eye opens when it enters combat mode.

species.name: Shignil
species.flavor: A dragon-type monster that manipulates wind. It learns strength and intelligence techniques simultaneously, and can even learn healing, making it adept at fighting at any range.

species.name: Shigue
species.flavor: A bird that breathes fire, even though fire is not its main attribute. In addition to fire-based techniques, it also has poisoning techniques and excels in mid-range combat.

species.name: Suezo
species.flavor: His specialty is stealing an opponent's will.

species.name: Suzurin
species.flavor: [[Dr. Shiroki]] found this fairy monster. The doctor found this monster so sweet that he just had to scream 'Woweee!'

species.name: Tiger
species.flavor: He is very popular with all types of people.

species.name: Thine
species.flavor: A monster with a hard, durable shell that prefers to live in dark places such as caves. Many are aggressive by nature and stalk their prey under the cover of darkness. They have excellent night vision, but if suddenly exposed to a bright light, they may become unable to move.

species.name: Undine
species.flavor: This is a legendary monster living deep in the ocean.

species.name: Wracky
species.flavor: It carries the grudges of the monsters killed in the battle.

species.name: Worm
species.flavor: His elastic tusk is useful in hitting foes at long range.

species.name: Xenon
species.flavor: The most powerful monster ever known has been reborn from the age of myths! Legend tells of Xenon being granted the title

species.name: Zan
species.flavor: The only thing this monster knows is how to fight. The [[Tochika]]ns saw this as a danger and sealed the monster away, but a [[Nahze|scientist]] recently revived it...

species.name: Zuum
species.flavor: It's pedigree is considered to be similar to the Dino species.

species.name: Zilla
species.flavor: Few trainers keep it because it is a glutton and is too big.

species.name: Zecca
species.flavor: A species that lives quietly in rocky outcrops found in the wastelands. Most are gentle and mild-tempered; however, once they begin defending their territory, they reveal a ferocious side and will continue fighting until they have brought down the intruder. They are especially adept at attacks that harness the power of lightning.

species.name: Aero
species.flavor: Has high [[Speed]] and will obey you well. Can be KO'ed easily.

species.name: Aloha Saurian
species.flavor: Girls dream of riding on this one when they get married.

species.name: Akihabana
species.flavor: A mysterious monster who is said to have come from the legendary [[Electri-City|Electri-city]]. They say its face sometimes shows this faraway cityscape.

species.name: Allure
species.flavor: Her mysterious eyes have a way of making you docile.

species.name: Queen Plant
species.flavor: Pollen and dust are constantly getting into his eyes.

species.name: Ambush
species.flavor: The Ambush was made for jungle fighting. With its camouflage body, once you lose sight of it, it's very difficult to find it again.

species.name: Abata
species.flavor: Originally a Zan prototype, it still has many of the original features of its robot beginnings. But it's unreliable, and once it runs wild there's no stopping it.

species.name: Aguila
species.flavor: Often mistaken for the [[Garu]]'s father, it's a different species entirely. Raised in a similar environment, their colors are similar, though.

species.name: Angel
species.flavor: You're lucky to be able to raise such a great monster.

species.name: Abyss-ish
species.flavor: Magic of the Abyss has taken three dimensional form, resulting in this special monster. Its existence is a mystery, and a lot of breeders have their eye on it.

species.name: Ace
species.flavor: Equipped with ability worthy of its name. Let’s raise an Ace among Aces!

species.name: Alhambra
species.flavor: Alhambra is said to be a spontaneous mutation of Doodle. With its serious and sincere gaze, it always seems to be checking something.

species.name: Aloha
species.flavor: This islander is a fashion plate who loves the ladies.

species.name: Abyssinian
species.flavor: Made with the premise of activity in the water. But stay under too long and water can leak in. Beware!

species.name: Omoro Knight
species.flavor: The long boots it received from [[King Marche|the king]] are more precious to it than its own life. Could they really possess a life of their own?

species.name: Angas
species.flavor: The armor of a man who rose from being a woodcutter to a knight was possessed by the spirit of the earth, becoming its guardian.

species.name: Anathema
species.flavor: It has killed countless people. Its scythe is red because it has continued to absorb blood.

species.name: Purple Hare
species.flavor: He's supposed to be low in [[Intelligence]] and high in [[Power]].

species.name: Ablessie
species.flavor: The Ablessie is able to swim between here and the afterlife. It's famous for the perplexing banded markings on its neck and body.

species.name: Agi
species.flavor: By allowing parasitic plants to live within its body and controlling them at will as weapons, it gained formidable combat power. Unfortunately, being plant-based means it is weak against fire, just as you'd expect.

species.name: Alabia Niton
species.flavor: ''Alabia'' means to appear and disappear.

species.name: Ammon
species.flavor: It usually stays completely still in one place, like a fossil.

species.name: Actopee
species.flavor: While monsters have been doing theatre for a long time, Actopee's performances seem especially popular among women.

species.name: Akashic
species.flavor: This slate-shaped monster is said to have everything from the beginning to the end of the universe recorded on it. Yet no one has been able to translate the unusual writing.

species.name: Amabile
species.flavor: It has a great sense of rhythm, but what makes it especially popular is its irresistible charm, something not seen in other Mogis. Apparently, people love how affectionate and cuddly it is.

species.name: Afro
species.flavor: There is a {{wk|wikipedia|planetarium}} inside. Since the shell kind of looks like a human face, this monster was once thought to bring bad luck.

species.name: Amenhotep
species.flavor: A dignified one who is loved by many noble people.

species.name: Amon
species.flavor: Although many consider its appearance strange, Amon thinks itself to be very cool. The spines on its head are its hairstyle.

species.name: Ainz
species.flavor: Also known as the 'Lord of Death,' this Joker-type monster is the most skilled in necromancy, among its many magical abilities. It seems to be hiding a secret weapon called 'Super-Tier Magic.'

species.name: Albedo
species.flavor: This species is characterized by its pure white dress and beautiful raven hair. It always acts calm in battle, and they say it carries a pillow with Ainz's image embroidered on it as a treasure.

species.name: Alcadeias
species.flavor: Said to be [[Hakuoh]]'s trump card, possessing the ability to seal all [[Henger]]s that do not transform into [[Mystery Disc]]s. Its special move is 'A*Spark,' which destroys enemies with pure, white light.

species.name: Antlan Red
species.flavor: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. It hates evil! With its bright red body and just heart, it's the leader of the group.

species.name: Armocchi
species.flavor: Some sections of its body have been hardened like armor.

species.name: Aqua Wool
species.flavor: Its shiny hair always looks like it just came out of the water and it has a slight mint smell. Its lovely behavior makes it a popular monster.

species.name: AnquiHare
species.flavor: It looks like it's always just spacing out but actually, nothing could be further from the truth. It can be reckless at times but it has a heart full of hope.

species.name: Ant Mew
species.flavor: Its blue face is actually just a mask. (A hero of justice never shows its true face!) Its fervor impresses all it meets, but it never can quite pull off the look.

species.name: Armor Dragon
species.flavor: They say it was used by humans for the ancient battles.

species.name: Anki
species.flavor: Covered with rocks, he has good power, but is slow.

species.name: AntKoro
species.flavor: The serious AntKoro always works hard and supports the others in its group. Humans could learn a lot from it. Watch it closely the next time you get a chance!

species.name: Armorcho
species.flavor: This monster is a big coward and rarely emerges from its protective, harder-than-stone shell. It takes some time for its [[breeder]] to become friends with it.

species.name: Arbor Mogi
species.flavor: Nobody'd better get unruly in its jungle, or it'll use its miraculous power on them! Nicknamed the

species.name: Anquiloden
species.flavor: The huge armor it was born with is extremely tough, so its muscles are flexible and it's very fluid in its battle moves. Knock it down and it stands back up again.

species.name: Antlan Blue
species.flavor: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. It lost its memory long ago, but it's doing OK now. Deftly displaying its abilities, it pulls the group together.

species.name: Antlan Yellow
species.flavor: One of the Antlan Rangers, a team of superheroes. Big and strong, it loves to eat. It can be scatterbrained at times, but the team loves him, anyway.

species.name: Plated Arrow
species.flavor: The real design of this monster is in the form of vapor.

species.name: AquaSpike
species.flavor: An Arrow Head well-adapted for the water. It has very few enemies living down there.

species.name: Antares
species.flavor: It is expected to function well both in water and on land.

species.name: Apocolis
species.flavor: Imitating bamboo, this [[Dragon]] is like an illusion you can't really see. I can't tell if it's only sleeping - there is still no one who knows for sure.

species.name: Arokken
species.flavor: It distracts its opponents with strange movements, then attacks with a sharp beak! It is not to be underestimated.

species.name: Aqua Mask
species.flavor: Wears a fabric that protects him from fire and water.

species.name: Aqua Knight
species.flavor: A monster clad in armor modeled after a [[crocodile]]. Despite its appearance, it has a surprisingly gentle and dignified personality - quite the gentleman, in fact.

species.name: ArchReaper
species.flavor: Originally, it was a god, but an evil heart sprouted within it, and it was banished by [[Deities|the others]]. Its ancient power still remains strong.

species.name: Ardebaren
species.flavor: One time master of the Castle of the Damned. Now reformed.

species.name: Mail Ripper
species.flavor: The MailRipper gives up some of its [[speed]] for a strong [[defense]]. Its steel scythe is razor sharp. This monster just smells of danger...

species.name: Anubis
species.flavor: Anubis lives alone in the desert, and it is very difficult to tame. It takes an experienced [[breeder]] to train it. You might be a good match.

species.name: ArmadiRoller
species.flavor: The thorny points come from the skin of Armadiroller. It is always curled up motionless behind the rocks, because it is just too hot.

species.name: Aqua-Cutter
species.flavor: Very similar to Jell monsters. He has a very soft body.

species.name: Anguish
species.flavor: A selfish brat who is always worried about things.

species.name: Arunelo
species.flavor: A relative of the Antero that lives in regions with heavy snowfall. During the summer it forms herds, while in the winter it spends its time traveling alone in search of food. Because it has an exceptionally gentle and people-friendly temperament, it is also commonly raised as livestock.

species.name: Aqua Mew
species.flavor: A monster mix which has given this one very high [[Defense|Def]]..

species.name: Angolmor
species.flavor: It is a Golem under control of [[Joker]]'s soul.

species.name: Aquamarine
species.flavor: A monster with a transparent body. The head is different in texture and is as hard as a jewel. It seems that many people keep it as an ornamental animal.

species.name: Aya (Zan)
species.flavor: She was created as a female version of the original Zan, but the process didn't go very well. (Her looks were the problem.) They finally settled on this version.

species.name: Baseball Boy
species.flavor: Its ultimate dream: a grand slam, walk-off home run. It's a pretty silly dream but nobody around it can get up the nerve to say so.

species.name: Battle Rocks
species.flavor: It is said that a giant's armor turned into this monster.

species.name: Bargest
species.flavor: From the time this monster is born in hell it has only one mission - to strip its opponents of all dignity. Its faintly glowing eyes are just looking for its chance.

species.name: Futorunner
species.flavor: Its great strides are moving to behold. Some say the name originally came from the fact that it often finds itself running subconsciously.

species.name: Baum
species.flavor: This Golem is made from a 1000-year-old oak tree. Birds build nests among the leaves.

species.name: BakuRoller
species.flavor: Its howl sounds like a horn and can be heard from a great distance. When the BakuRoller's herd starts getting rough, nobody can stop them.

species.name: Baby Dino
species.flavor: A monster that lives in an ancient dinosaur-egg fossil. Even though it has some dinosaur blood in its veins, it's a peaceful monster. It doesn't like conflict.

species.name: Battleleon
species.flavor: Long ago, when nobles used to enjoy indoor battles, the Battleleon held an unbeaten record. It's a reliable monster that carries out orders to the letter.

species.name: Bazoo
species.flavor: It resides in a harsh location, and has its own values.

species.name: Bastet
species.flavor: Bastet is normally a gentle monster, but when its wrath is unleashed, an extremely fearful side is revealed. Bastet is a cat lover, and will probably treat those well who bring along a cat.

species.name: Baku Clown
species.flavor: It was born as a tool of devils, but it forgets its evil duty.

species.name: Baksheesh
species.flavor: The tusks on the lower jaw can throw anyone. Only rarely does this Baku turn violent, but once it starts to turn, no one can stop it.

species.name: Baku-ish
species.flavor: Baku-ish will eat anything. Once it got something stuck in its throat and turned blue, barely surviving the incident. But to this day it remains that odd bluish color.

species.name: Avalanche
species.flavor: The horn is as cold as an icicle and radiates cold air. When two horns of these monsters touch, they freeze together!

species.name: Athena
species.flavor: Everybody agrees on its strength, but few agree on its looks.

species.name: Automaton
species.flavor: It is said that it was made as a prototype for Henger.

species.name: Avaoner
species.flavor: It can fly swiftly in the air using its large wings. On the ground, however, its wings get stuck in alleys and doorways. Very inconvenient.

species.name: Astraal
species.flavor: A soul born from the earth is returned to the earth. For that purpose, it is said to have been created.

species.name: Bakky
species.flavor: It never used to be bought at the shop, but it has become popular.

species.name: Baby Doll
species.flavor: This monster is a doll of Pixie with a wicked soul.

species.name: Basilisk
species.flavor: It confuses its enemies with a special pattern on its body.

species.name: AssasiRipper
species.flavor: The AssasiRipper is nocturnal. It tears around at high speed no matter how dark it is. But during the day, the sunlight bothers it and it slows down considerably.

species.name: Dandelion
species.flavor: His long, fluffy fur makes him look much larger.

species.name: Baskerville
species.flavor: It's as if it were bad since it was born, but it actually just does not like being alone and is a little twisted. So, Breeders, don't be afraid and take good care of it.

species.name: Baum Kuchen
species.flavor: ''Baumkuchen'' is German for

species.name: Asphaltum
species.flavor: Don't try and sneak up on this strange monster.

species.name: MotoRoller
species.flavor: Its name is BariRoller. No one can run faster. Its eyes are full of the sadness and happiness of running.

species.name: Bazula
species.flavor: Very precise vision with his small eyes make him feared.

species.name: Aspis
species.flavor: As the deadly colors on its skin show, it has poisonous fangs, claws, and tail. They say it cannot help dancing when it hears a flute melody.

species.name: Weed
species.flavor: A poisonous plant that's made from some rancid water.

species.name: Black Plant
species.flavor: Although his true color is green, he appears black.

species.name: BambiiMew
species.flavor: This Mew has adapted to a forest setting. The pattern on its back resembles light streaming through the leaves of a tree, for great camouflage.

species.name: Astro
species.flavor: It is said that this monster contains a Metalner in it.

species.name: Axer
species.flavor: Its sculpted body and performance make it popular. Has a killer move.

species.name: Baby Dragon
species.flavor: Like a Dragon, it can breathe fire and has wings, but they are too small to allow it to fly.

species.name: Asakura
species.flavor: He always gives a laid-back impression, casually enjoying nature alone in the grasslands. But in battle, he is sharp and quick-witted, and the band he wears on his head appear to be earmuffs that produce sound.

species.name: MewBear
species.flavor: A mysterious and popular one who's stronger than he looks.

species.name: Beetle Mocchi
species.flavor: The BettleMochi is crazy about sweets. Of course, it watches the calories, too. It's great friends with the [[Draco Mocchi|Draco Moch]], another member of the Mocchi family.

species.name: Beakie
species.flavor: Its odd hat is a symbol of the important position it used to hold. But it's long since forgotten this fact, and now wears it because it thinks it looks good.

species.name: OwlMochi
species.flavor: The best martial artist of all Mocchis, it's never been beaten. At least, that's the rumor that's been going around. (It's a little upset about this rumor.)

species.name: Big Korobocci
species.flavor: It has many faces, but it only has one true head. When it wakes up in the morning, all of its eyes open at the same time. ...Kind of creepy, huh?

species.name: Bighand
species.flavor: This kind of monsters are considered to be extinct.

species.name: Beerock
species.flavor: Its rocky body may be hollow inside, because it can fly.

species.name: Beegator
species.flavor: Its large, sharp claws are powerful enough to rip steel with just one swipe. It used to use its giant mouth, but it's degenerated so much it won't even open now.

species.name: Berserker
species.flavor: The soul of a bandit chief came to dwell within this suit of armor. Its no-rules, anything-goes fighting style is truly terrifying!

species.name: Beetle Fish
species.flavor: The Beetle Fish has looked exactly the same for thousands of years, and so it's nicknamed the

species.name: Blakkus
species.flavor: It favors the darkness over the light. It has a bad mouth, but it isn’t truly bad deep down.

species.name: Tri-Eye
species.flavor: A battle legend who charges across the arena with flowing blonde hair. It is said that its stubborn personality might be its only flaw.

species.name: Black Lion
species.flavor: Its black body helps it avoid being seen. Some even take advantage of that to sneak out and play at night - quite the mischief-makers.

species.name: Beeslim
species.flavor: Although it often works out, it is not seeing much result. It is still looking for the dumbbells it lost last week.

species.name: Beaclon-ish
species.flavor: This monster changed its color to hide from young breeders obsessed with beetles. But now that it's no longer sought after, life's gotten a little more lonely.

species.name: Bethelgeus
species.flavor: The image of its flying in the sky is called 'Death's Dance.'

species.name: Bercouger
species.flavor: Forever the rival of Beaklon, its pincers are just as powerful as Beaklon's horn.

species.name: Beralsekt
species.flavor: Even ordinary Madillos have hard shells, but this monster's whole body is so hard nobody can hurt it! It's nocturnal, so it sleeps during the day.

species.name: Black Rex
species.flavor: Above average in all areas. Doesn't trust anyone though.

species.name: Bengal
species.flavor: All Jills are gluttons.This one loves to eat fruits.

species.name: Black Henger
species.flavor: Once wielded an evil power. He no longer has it.

species.name: Beowulf
species.flavor: A brave and fearless knight with no desire for personal gain. It is said to have defeated countless villains, and its exploits have even become the subject of famous stories.

species.name: Benemale
species.flavor: Sometimes kind, sometimes mean — it's hard to tell which is its true nature. Perhaps justice and evil are constantly fighting inside its heart?

species.name: Beretta
species.flavor: Beretta was born of a picture book to hunt down evildoers. If it even senses a hint of evil, it will not rest until its target is brought to justice.

species.name: Biansnow
species.flavor: Be careful not to mess with its hairstyle, because it gets very upset. Make sure you redo its hair after every battle.

species.name: Black Worm
species.flavor: His sleek black shell makes him good at pulling things.

species.name: Black Saurian
species.flavor: Its body with a black luster attracts fashionable people.

species.name: Birdie
species.flavor: Say, 'Nice shot!' when you want to praise it for its good work.

species.name: Blue Phoenix
species.flavor: Unlike other Phoenix monsters, it is very violent.

species.name: BearRoller
species.flavor: One day, a [[Tochika|Tochikan]] girl was taking a walk in the woods when she found this monster. Since the monster kept following her, she decided to keep it.

species.name: Hooligan
species.flavor: Living on the streets, it is never without its sunglasses. Shrewder than the other Mogis, it often ditches [[training]].

species.name: Black Mocchi
species.flavor: Black Mocchi loves to drape itself in dark colors, and even tried to blacken its heart once. That didn't go over too well with the fan base, so apparently it killed that idea.

species.name: Bikini
species.flavor: This 'poser' likes to show everyone his great build.

species.name: Big-Tokobot
species.flavor: A [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karakuri_puppet Karakuri]-Combination type Tokobot. Its firm body deflects all attacks, drawing strength from 8 bots! But its slow movement can be lifetaking.

species.name: Black Golem
species.flavor: His stealth colored body makes him hard to see.

species.name: Big Blue
species.flavor: An ice-carved giant who is better known as 'Ice Rock.'

species.name: Bowbow
species.flavor: It took a nap on the ground one day and wound up this color! It stores up its energy during sleep and then uses it all in battle. Then it goes back to sleep again.

species.name: Boochin
species.flavor: Its big nose can vacuum up anything. Its power is so great, it once sucked up all the mushrooms in the [[Morx|Morx Forest]].

species.name: Blobster
species.flavor: A vicious monster with scorpion poison strong enough to lay even the great [[Baku]] low. Its powerful scorpion claws make a can opener unnecessary.

species.name: Pulscorn
species.flavor: Known to have dark, trusting eyes which show good [[loyalty]].

species.name: BowMew
species.flavor: An odd mix of part doll, part cat, and part [[Tiger]].

species.name: Blocken
species.flavor: This monster's duck-like shape is made up of several rocks.

species.name: Blixy Klingy (??? Sub)
species.flavor: Using infrasonic math, DJ {{IMDB|nm1818640|Kaz Gamble}} & Singer {{wk|wikipedia|Sisely Treasure}} decomposed sound into its most elementary frequencies, creating this stylish and trendy monster.

species.name: EvilBeak
species.flavor: This monster is a respected demon warrior. It has an iron will and follows its orders to the letter, so it can seem brutal at times. Be careful how you approach it!

species.name: Boxer Bajarl
species.flavor: It has great footwork even without feet.

species.name: Bossy
species.flavor: Although lazy, this one is a top-notch monster.

species.name: Blue Thunder
species.flavor: This tribe is considered to be the descendant of Thor.

species.name: Brickidee
species.flavor: Even with the influence of [[Monol]], the Monster Association says this rare monster is quite cute. Because of its solid personality, it's valued by the experts.

species.name: Bouken
species.flavor: A reckless troublemaker. It confuses its opponents with unpredictable, chaotic movements.

species.name: Brinjalen
species.flavor: It looks just like an eggplant, but it is actually a mysterious object of unknown origin. However, everyone believes it is just an eggplant.

species.name: Bloody Eye
species.flavor: Its unique red eyes have caused it to be put on public display.

species.name: Bloss
species.flavor: It is inhabited by the soul of an honest swordsman who, after cutting down a cherry tree, properly confessed to his parents.

species.name: Boo
species.flavor: A monster that has come from the far East, devoting itself to scaring people. The bandana around its head is a symbol of proof of it winning the championship to scare people.

species.name: Blue Terror
species.flavor: It painlessly kills its enemy with one deadly attack.

species.name: Bloodshed
species.flavor: This is the most aggressive monster of all the Joker species.

species.name: Jelly Hare
species.flavor: His transparent body shows the odd tail that he has.

species.name: Blue Kato
species.flavor: Its quick movements make its enemy confused.

species.name: Blizzarin
species.flavor: Blizzarin comes in December and gives presents to children, but if you've been bad, you may not get any.

species.name: Bree
species.flavor: This clown-like monster has a small body but a fierce heart in battle, using various tricks and movements to win.

species.name: Red Eye
species.flavor: This guy likes to stay out late instead of sleeping.

species.name: Bronze Suezo
species.flavor: It is another rare one, for its body is the color bronze.

species.name: Blue Sponge
species.flavor: His firm body and soft, rich fur would make for a good bed.

species.name: Crimson-Eyed
species.flavor: He doesn't like to battle any weak monsters. Loves to fight.

species.name: Bloodstra
species.flavor: Far deep into the [[Devil's Forest|forest of the demons]], take the lives of those who visit the castle with its sharp fangs. It is a monster to be feared, although it's rumored to have a lot of weaknesses.

species.name: Breeza
species.flavor: Said to be shown in conjunction with the aurora. It has been nicknamed the 'Snowfield Queen.'

species.name: Bosco
species.flavor: This monster likes reed whistles, and walks around whistling all the time. Since it tries to use all kinds of grasses, sometimes its lips get swollen.

species.name: Blue Plant
species.flavor: Besides having a nice smile, he is very easy to breed.

species.name: Bonsai
species.flavor: This little guy is extremely popular among landscapers.

species.name: Blixy Klingy (Ducken Sub)
species.flavor: Blixy Klingy was found clinging to a rock on a gourd-shaped island. It's known to blow up in anger when people say it looks like a pirate. But we don't think that, do we?

species.name: Brix
species.flavor: It has the flexibility of an octopus. It can even confuse its opponents and escape when necessary.

species.name: Bolshack
species.flavor: [[Shobu]]'s trump card, a valiant dragon with a [[Aura|Red aura]], is said to have destroyed any city it has entered. Its ultimate attack, 'B-Fire,' burns everything to ashes.

species.name: Captain Bird
species.flavor: With a just heart that fits the title of a captain. Permitting no wrong, it uses its polished skill to enforce justice everywhere.

species.name: Bunny
species.flavor: Very popular among the male breeders. Can hide in battle.

species.name: Burning Wall
species.flavor: This one escaped from its trainer while its stable was on fire.

species.name: Caloriena
species.flavor: This monster never ceases its exercise and diet regiment.

species.name: Fairy Hare
species.flavor: It has a weak, out-of-shape, and flabby stomach.

species.name: Centurion
species.flavor: Its body is covered with well-designed solid armor.

species.name: Chaos Dragon
species.flavor: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. It has god-like power, but its tendency to think very highly of itself makes the other two scoff.

species.name: Chaos Durahan
species.flavor: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. A dark, majestic war deity with armor polished through countless battles with strong men.

species.name: Ceto
species.flavor: The Ceto is a strong, fast machine. It's programmed to know all of the Naga's maneuvers, but that program is broken so you'll have to start from scratch.

species.name: Bug Bug Flower
species.flavor: The Gobbler Flower has three mouths so it eats more than you'd think. (It takes in whatever else it needs through its roots.) This one is expensive to feed!

species.name: CarRoller
species.flavor: A powerful and high-precision Rhinoroller, it has a well-balanced body and smooth suspension. Quality from top to bottom! It's got lots of great options, too.

species.name: Pharaoh Eye
species.flavor: A loner who loves going on long journeys. The red sunset reflects well on it.

species.name: Caro
species.flavor: A monster who boasts fancy pink scissors. It feels uneasy about having its claws get dirty in battle.

species.name: Canaloa
species.flavor: Canaloa’s body is covered in a rubbery shell. It can repel any attack!

species.name: Carame
species.flavor: Its body is covered with sand, but the inside is full of Jell water. They sometimes help desert wanderers with this water.

species.name: Capitano
species.flavor: A performer with ample pride and heart. Battling is a stage to it. Its battle spectacle never lets spectators down.

species.name: Centaur-ish
species.flavor: Centaur-ish is tired of walking on 4 legs, and is working hard to grow 2 more. It is often scolded by others for its silly thoughts and poor concentration in battle.

species.name: Celious
species.flavor: It is a loner and does not like to cluster.

species.name: Cantalos
species.flavor: Cantalos emits a sweet odor from its body to confuse its enemies. Don't go too close, because the smell will stay with you for days!

species.name: Cawken
species.flavor: Some people consider this monster to be unlucky.

species.name: Chacken
species.flavor: It has evolved, gaining the power of the [[Element|earth]]. Memories of the [[Timeline of Pangaean History|ancient times]] may soon begin to awaken...

species.name: Capsular
species.flavor: It may look a bit unappealing, but its body is said to be filled with medicine. People call it a 'walking first-aid kit' and treasure it.

species.name: Brown Mask
species.flavor: An elegant one who doesn't wish to be conservative.

species.name: Burstliner
species.flavor: The heaviest of all the Hengers. It is good at making roads and tunnels, and its earthshaking attacks are very powerful.

species.name: Bushi-Do
species.flavor: A master swordsman who came from the east. Its skill can sever even iron, and it devotes its life entirely to refining its swordsmanship.

species.name: Tactics
species.flavor: Cabaree came from a different world called [[Worn Hope]]. Its 'Superior Lance' technique is touted as an art form.

species.name: Brownie
species.flavor: It has a gentle and mild-mannered personality, unusual for a Gitan. Only children are said to be able to see it. Apparently, it’s friends with the Mitsubara.

species.name: Burrole
species.flavor: Burrole loves to chatter, but never listens to what anyone else has to say! Those big ears are only there so it can hear its own voice.

species.name: Campanella
species.flavor: A monster that lives on the boundary between dreams and reality. If you become friends with it, it might even invite you on a journey to the [[DreamWorld|world of dreams]].

species.name: Cactun
species.flavor: This cactus always stands silently, but sometimes it just has to jump. It's affectionate toward people, but nothing can save the person it attacks.

species.name: Celeris
species.flavor: Celeris is not very popular, but once you actually raise one, you’ll realize that is a mistake. It’s surprisingly capable after all.

species.name: Caesar
species.flavor: Caesar is a brutal killing machine modeled after Xenon. It has no emotions, and only acts on response to orders. But lately it has been experiencing something close to feelings.

species.name: Bui
species.flavor: As a result of living under the strong desert sun, unnecessary body water has evaporated. This is how this monster became lighter and faster than a normal Zan.

species.name: Cabalos
species.flavor: A troublemaker who will run away often and come back wild.

species.name: Cari
species.flavor: A very strong one who has saved the lives of many.

species.name: Butcher King
species.flavor: A character with a passion for battles more than other Golems and a very wild character. It also possesses a degree of mischievousness, and its fickleness is unequaled in comparison.

species.name: Clown Lessie
species.flavor: From bustling [[Kaniwa|Naniwa]], it loves lively places and can't relax when it's quiet. Some think it's cute and others think it's gross, but it doesn't care either way.

species.name: Chaos Ripper
species.flavor: One of the three beast gods that ruled over the monsters long ago. Its disagreeable temperament is a problem but it has god-like [[speed]] that doesn't let anything near.

species.name: Clear Suezo
species.flavor: He likes to eat and is always sure to brush his teeth.

species.name: ChuMew
species.flavor: This healing monster has a beautiful singing voice. Especially popular with small children.

species.name: Succhi
species.flavor: 'Welcome!' Succhi says this all the time, but it doesn't make much sense. It had two friends, but after a fight, they left. It likes to wake up early.

species.name: Cocadrille
species.flavor: The Cocadrille does not like drawing attention to itself, but it grows very quickly. One day, it may suddenly become gigantic overnight.

species.name: Cookun
species.flavor: His goal is to become the world's best chef, so every day he is busy studying. But, the truth is that his own body is the most delicious thing.

species.name: Corkasus
species.flavor: It is difficult to find it since it hardly leaves its homeland.

species.name: ComedyKoro
species.flavor: These monsters love the comic-strip characters in their breeders' magazines. They all wear masks but it's the one with the sunglasses that always has bad luck.

species.name: Coconutty
species.flavor: Coconutty's flower petals work like radar. It's good at gathering information and fights methodically, looking over the data it collects on its opponents first.

species.name: Condorin
species.flavor: Its fierce determination doesn't seem to go with its tiny body. It really wants to win, but when it comes time for the actual battle, it has a hard time.

species.name: Ciseaux
species.flavor: Its claws' hardness is outstanding among the Arrow Heads. There is nothing in this world it can’t cut.

species.name: Chinois
species.flavor: The dish that it cooked tastes so good that makes you smile.

species.name: Muddy Jell
species.flavor: His clay body allows him to turn into many shapes.

species.name: Clay (Monol Sub)
species.flavor: Though native to volcanic lands, he does not like the heat.

species.name: Chaser
species.flavor: No matter how the opponent tries to escape, its scissors that can shrink or extend, and it won't let them get away!

species.name: Chariot
species.flavor: It is said that it holds the souls of Durahan and Centaur.

species.name: Color Pandora-ish
species.flavor: Each of the Color Pandora-ish bodies are extremely shy, and don't want people staring at them, so they all painted their faces the same color.

species.name: ChaosHead
species.flavor: A dragon whose high [[intelligence]] ended up turning into cunning. It is deeply vengeful, so if it ever sets its sights on you, you’re in serious trouble.

species.name: Chef
species.flavor: It flies around cooking a large variety of food at one time.

species.name: Colorful
species.flavor: This weary monster can't last very long in battles.

species.name: Dark-Bringer
species.flavor: Its hand is a knife, and it can see in the dark. Thus, people say that this monster must have been an assassination device in ancient times.

species.name: Cinder Bird
species.flavor: Contrary to its looks, it is burning furiously inside.

species.name: Corone
species.flavor: He is a quiet guy who looks like he is a stuffed-animal.

species.name: Coltan
species.flavor: Despite the glowing body, sharp eyes, and stern looks, it's really just lonely, and wants some friends to play with.

species.name: Clocker
species.flavor: The king of a [[Nettle Kingdom|certain country]] created a Joker doll to frighten his people. Then one day, it began moving all by itself.

species.name: ChuraMaya
species.flavor: Its flexible and smooth body considered to be the most beautiful out of all Maya species quickly attracts many breeders. But it has very deep pride, and does not accept cheap food.

species.name: Citronie
species.flavor: It likes using a fighting style that confuses its enemies.

species.name: Coral (Monster)
species.flavor: Its texture is soft like a sponge. It feels so good you want to sleep on its back.

species.name: Chaos Xenon
species.flavor: One of the most powerful monsters from the age of myths. An ancient curse has taken hold, shrouding it in a dark aura.

species.name: ClockDog
species.flavor: It is a masterpiece created by [[Dr. Zarnycie]] using the gadget technology. It still awaits the return of the doctor, even after his death upon completion.

species.name: Clear Shell
species.flavor: Its gelled section is almost as hard as its shell.

species.name: Chloro Jell
species.flavor: Be sure to keep him wet, or he will get dehydrated.

species.name: Coconut
species.flavor: It moves by drifting in the ocean, so it was thought to be a tiny island. They even called this monster 'Floating Isle.'

species.name: Chopanjel
species.flavor: A monster that seems like a refreshing dessert, with jelly-like body contained in a jelly-like bowl. Its popularity raises dramatically during the summer.

species.name: Cheshire
species.flavor: A laid-back and elusive personality. They have fun messing with their Breeders, using pranks to gage their reactions.

species.name: Mucchi
species.flavor: Research proves touching this monster's skin has a restorative affect. Currently, it's enjoying a huge popularity among women. Hope it's not just another fad...

species.name: Darkcell
species.flavor: A certain monster was so mad it got beat by a Joker that its rage took form and became this monster. Now it'll do everything to beat that Joker!

species.name: Crevasse
species.flavor: It has a habit of hiding things like a dog.

species.name: Curevis
species.flavor: This phantom knight, clad in pumpkin armor, uses its hatchet to punish monsters who dare to wreak havoc in its pumpkin patch. It wears a pumpkin god on its waist.

species.name: Kagemusha
species.flavor: Clad in dark armor, it hides within the darkness and eliminates its enemies. If it stands as your ally, there is no greater reassurance.

species.name: Cyclops
species.flavor: Although he has only one eye, he is powerful. Has high [[intelligence]].

species.name: Cybernetico
species.flavor: Its steel drill makes its enemies tremble in fear. It spins at high speed, sending sparks flying, so even its [[Breeder]] needs to be careful.

species.name: Dark Antlan
species.flavor: With the strength of the three beast gods and the heart of the Antlan Rangers, it's a powerful dark hero. The dark blade in its hands slashes through evil.

species.name: Cosmic Abyss
species.flavor: This special creature was born in ancient times to bring order to the universe. Its fight to change chaos to cosmos still continues to this day.

species.name: Cutie (Antlan)
species.flavor: Its fashionable color scheme is very effective. It’s anxious for a fight.

species.name: CousCous
species.flavor: Among the Garus, the CousCous is especially impatient and easily flustered. However, it always does its best, which makes it very popular with everyone.

species.name: CyanGaru
species.flavor: CyanGaru loves the sea and is always swimming or diving. If left alone, it will keep swimming all day long. It’s a very tough creature.

species.name: Cutey
species.flavor: A human-mix that has an attractiveness about it.

species.name: Dark Piercer
species.flavor: When pierced in the heart by a dark spear, it did not die, but its heart was blackened. Some say the Dark Piercer pierced its own heart on that fateful day.

species.name: Crab Dragon
species.flavor: It inhabits a lake and rules that lake.

species.name: Cuekan
species.flavor: The mimic-loving Cuekan even repeats scoldings back to you. Raising it might require a lot of patience.

species.name: Cu Chulainn
species.flavor: A hero who has been granted a portion of divine power. Once it makes a promise, it will keep it even if it costs its own life — the embodiment of true [[loyalty]].

species.name: Four-Eyed
species.flavor: If you look closely at him, you will see his 4 eyes.

species.name: Cupid Hare
species.flavor: This cute pink Hare has, at some point, come to be known as the god of love. If you have an unrequited love, why not try raising one?

species.name: Crescent
species.flavor: An evil spirit is dwelling in it because of a forbidden drink.

species.name: Crab Saurian
species.flavor: It can swim fast in water and it is also a fast runner.

species.name: Dalphi
species.flavor: This is a rare black and white Octopee! I've heard there are only 102 in the whole world!

species.name: Cowbird
species.flavor: A Cowbird here from the edge of the wilds. It puts on its prideful hat, and with its quick-draw Western punch aims for the loot.

species.name: Crawl
species.flavor: This monster is absolutely confident in its swimming ability. With its high-tech swimming suit on, it trains every day to become #1 in the world.

species.name: Dack Plant
species.flavor: A monster with petals coming in three flamboyant colors. It is said to be getting energy by exposing those petals to wind and turning them around like windmills.

species.name: Cream Puff
species.flavor: Although it's wrapped in a shell that looks like a delicious puff, this shell is actually a lot harder than it looks and enhances its defense like other Pancho breeds. What's troublesome is to see children crying after they learn they can't have one.

species.name: Cosmocchi
species.flavor: It was predicted this Mocchi will one day save the world. But it doesn't know that yet, and lives every day peacefully, calm and relaxed.

species.name: Dao
species.flavor: It moves each part of its body by using a mysterious magic.

species.name: Elebus
species.flavor: This shiny and highly visible Golem is made entirely of ice. It is very popular during hot summer days.

species.name: Dagon
species.flavor: Its hard body can even resist the pressures in the deep ocean.

species.name: Dango
species.flavor: Scary-looking, but gentle and caring. Likes listening to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Enka Enka].

species.name: Crab Dino
species.flavor: Thanks to its smooth shell, it is able to swim feely underwater. Handshakes are strictly prohibited, as it has pincers for hands.

species.name: Denken
species.flavor: The middle-aged men who meet Denkun end up getting home late, so it isn’t popular with their wives. It’s an idol to uncles everywhere.

species.name: Death Wing
species.flavor: This monster is formed from evil feelings. Because of all these emotions inside it often behaves strangely, but it never harms people. It hates all other monsters.

species.name: Devi
species.flavor: The Devi is the leader of some group. It runs around town trying to get everyone together. If you see it in the streets, let it know you're rooting for it!

species.name: Pink Golem
species.flavor: A shy, quiet guy who is loved by many. Has high [[Intelligence|Int]]..

species.name: Datonare
species.flavor: No one equals its speed when it runs through the forest.

species.name: DarkWhip
species.flavor: The DarkWhip has a scary face, but it's just a gentle monster that eats nothing but fruit. Apparently, it uses its sickle arms to peel this fruit.

species.name: Diaboros
species.flavor: It is said that this dragon was resurrected by Joker's power.

species.name: Draco Hopper
species.flavor: Though its potential is high, few people raise such a scary looking monster.

species.name: Dixie
species.flavor: This one has razor sharp claws to cut one to pieces.

species.name: MocchiGaru
species.flavor: Having Mocchi’s blood in its lineage, its body is extremely soft and very stretchy. The fact that it can’t swim is not well known.

species.name: DeviMadillo
species.flavor: The DeviMadillo is from the [[Land of Chaos|demon world]]. A strict dojo coach, it swings its bamboo sword around threateningly.

species.name: Dice
species.flavor: This monster has strange patterns on its body.

species.name: Disrupt
species.flavor: This monster has a unique black and white coloration.

species.name: Diva
species.flavor: It reigns above all monsters. Its existence is completely shrouded in mystery.

species.name: Dodongo (Dragon)
species.flavor: This dragon can only be seen in the desert area.

species.name: Dokken
species.flavor: It polishes its acorn body until it is shiny. The woodland creatures then use it as a mirror.

species.name: Dokoo
species.flavor: It carries a type of poison that paralyzes other monsters.

species.name: Dickens
species.flavor: Dickens is always pulling pranks. But the truth is, it only does it because it wants attention. If you let it join your group, it will stop causing mischief.

species.name: Depstalker
species.flavor: It is said that the souls of the citizens of an [[Sunken Temple|ancient city]] that sank into the sea became Depstalkers.

species.name: Drabitt
species.flavor: Covered in hard red scales, it looks like a flame, although it has fondness for sweet and cold food. It earned a reputation as a cut and affectionate monster once it gets close to the breeder.

species.name: Diamante
species.flavor: The horns that grow out every year become valuable gemstones. Many wedding rings are made from them. Girls often long for one.

species.name: Deluxe Liner
species.flavor: It swims confidently but there is something anxious about it.

species.name: Draco Doll
species.flavor: The original version of this doll is sold at a premium price.

species.name: Dento
species.flavor: A hound with a true

species.name: Daton
species.flavor: He will hit an opponent from out of nowhere. Breed him well.

species.name: Dobor I.T.
species.flavor: This Tiger once saved a girl from a burning house. Its fur burned away and gave it this new look.

species.name: Dorara
species.flavor: A monster with its pride held up high with the soul of a [[Dragon]] resided in it. But it is not able to blow fire. It keeps on training day and night, to build up its skills and performance.

species.name: Death Clown
species.flavor: A feared monster who is known as a clown from hell. It serves the monster king, although its true intentions are not known. Is it with you? Or against you? That is up to the breeder to decide.

species.name: Disc Niton
species.flavor: It has a pattern design that looks like a disc stone.

species.name: Dominos
species.flavor: These monsters like to gather and form a line.

species.name: Devil Mew
species.flavor: A monster that came into being by the residing of the monster king inside the Mew doll. It can be tamed quite easily as it purrs while it is stroked below its chin.

species.name: Diablo
species.flavor: In the world that it comes from, it is known as one of the primordial demons. It is said to resemble the devil, but its demeanor is genteel. It seems to absolutely adore [[Rimuru]].

species.name: Draco Mocchi
species.flavor: Contrary to its cute movements, it is a violent monster.

species.name: Hipzo
species.flavor: The Hipzo is very proud of its big hat. But there's a rumor going around that it's actually so heavy it's thinking about taking it off and throwing it away.

species.name: Drill Mocchi
species.flavor: The DrillMochi is a great dancer, is up on the trends and is really particular about fashion. Despite all this, it's really shy and often hides in holes.

species.name: Eagle King
species.flavor: The Eagle King has huge rock talons to grab its opponents with. It loves high places, and dreams of flying through the sky one day. It might have to diet first, though.

species.name: Ducklon
species.flavor: It has a spring that has to be wound each morning.

species.name: Drimole
species.flavor: The Drimole smells great. You can always tell it's there (even from far away) by the fragrance. Its was discovered only recently, so nobody knows much about it.

species.name: Duck Fever
species.flavor: It is very good at playing ball; however, it’s a bit of a troublemaker that cares more about the game than its Breeder.

species.name: Drarin
species.flavor: A monster from the [[land of Night]]. Though it looks dangerous, it actually will faint if it sees blood. It is very popular in the land of Night.

species.name: Ecologia
species.flavor: The Ecologia loves nature and is the protector of the forest. Enjoying the flowers and plants, it patrols among the trees. Nobody had better disturb the forest's peace!

species.name: Dryad
species.flavor: This monster is a tree fairy. It inhabits in the forest.

species.name: Dragoon (Antlan)
species.flavor: Knick-named 'Hard-Puncher' for its two fists. Its body may be small, but its courage is huge.

species.name: Dragoon (Centaur)
species.flavor: This monster is the mixture of a brave Dragon and a just Centaur.

species.name: Eared Mew
species.flavor: This monster comes as part of the Hare monster type.

species.name: DriviDillo
species.flavor: It revs its roaring engine, and hopes to one day be the star of the racing circuit. Put the pedal to the metal! The word

species.name: Dragcatze
species.flavor: A monster with a body and claws that shine brilliantly, and a cruel nature that makes it toy with its enemies.

species.name: Dragster
species.flavor: It is gentle and cute, making it popular among the Dragon species. The ease of raising it is also part of its appeal.

species.name: Dragon-ish
species.flavor: Legend tells of a Dragon slayer with a holy lance, who once challenged a Dragon that turned blue and fled in fright. Today that Dragon is known as the

species.name: Druger
species.flavor: This divine dragon used to be called ''Pi-Long''. It has been fighting so long it has forgotten anything else exists in the world.

species.name: Duckis
species.flavor: Duckis looks very intimidating in its black armor, but it's actually akin to a spoiled child. Play video games all day, and your mom's gonna yell at you!

species.name: Ducken-ish
species.flavor: This creature was made in a rush, and its creator forgot to paint it, so it's still the color of its original material, whatever that material may be...

species.name: Durahan-ish
species.flavor: A drawing of a suit of armor seems to have become a monster. It may be an odd color, but it's strong as steel with tough armor and a sharp weapon.

species.name: Drydon
species.flavor: The reincarnation of a man born, raised, and killed at sea. The ax of blue metal is said to be strong enough to slice into other dimensions.

species.name: Draco Kato
species.flavor: It contains Dragon's violent blood and likes battle.

species.name: Ebony
species.flavor: This monster lives to confuse and surprise humans.

species.name: Drill-Tusk
species.flavor: The sharp horn on his head is his weak-point in battle.

species.name: Dribbler
species.flavor: 'Kickball' is the most popular sport in the [[IMa]] area.

species.name: Earth-Keeper
species.flavor: A monster who loves the great outdoors and enjoys nature.

species.name: Echidna
species.flavor: A black Naga that came from the darkness. Its powers are unknown. A very mysterious monster.

species.name: Duck Mew
species.flavor: A new product, Ducken doll, which has become very popular with its confusing design. But it has got possessed for some reason and turned into a monster!

species.name: Ecologuardia
species.flavor: Although mostly quiet, he is a terror when he gets angry.

species.name: Dream Golem
species.flavor: An amber body filled with happiness and sorrow. Just like a dream.

species.name: Durandal
species.flavor: A monster created using all kinds of modern technology, it is said to be a reproduction of a legendary monster that was once believed to be immortal.

species.name: Dreamy
species.flavor: Illumina and Mew dolls have bodies with surprisingly similar texture, giving this monster a cute appearance that is very popular, especially with young women.

species.name: Dryad (Ark)
species.flavor: It is usually laid back, but when it comes to those who destroy the environment, it transforms into a beautiful woman and bravely confronts them. It is good friends with the [[Earth-Keeper]] and [[Ecologuardia]].

species.name: Eyebee
species.flavor: The Eyebee can see through absolutely anything with its huge, green eye. (But, to tell the truth, it's kind of sick of being able to see everything...)

species.name: PengiMochi
species.flavor: It is similar to a penguin, but they are not related at all.

species.name: Eyengel
species.flavor: Aside from the glittering halo over its head, the most remarkable feature of this monster is the alarming yellow color of its teeth. It is known to hate dentists.

species.name: Eggukken
species.flavor: A rumor suggests there is a raw Eggukkung and a boiled Eggukkung, though it's probably just a bad joke by Breeders who missed breakfast.

species.name: Electrieel
species.flavor: This monster mutated from a huge [[Lantern Fish]]. They say lightning hitting the fish is what triggered the transformation.

species.name: Emerald Eye
species.flavor: It is said that it loves to eat jewelry, especially emeralds.

species.name: Fake Graffiti
species.flavor: The old Doodle with a new shape! Completely improved, it's now pretty impressive with its serious battle skills and slim body. (But it's still kind of a joke.)

species.name: Evil Fish
species.flavor: Like a ninja, it sneaks stealthily up and lays its opponent out in one blow. When it wants some attention from its [[breeder]], it creeps up and startles them.

species.name: Eval
species.flavor: It will beat its enemy senseless with its fast and powerful attacks. An antihero, hated by many.

species.name: Eve (Pixie)
species.flavor: One who will obey you well. Born under the Devil's will.

species.name: Ent
species.flavor: The Ent lives deep in the forest, protecting it from intruders. It always makes sure to

species.name: Eye Jell
species.flavor: He studies you with his x-ray eye ball that can see all.

species.name: Eggplantern
species.flavor: It is said that those who waste food are scolded by this monster.

species.name: Fafneel
species.flavor: This smart Dragon first immobilizes its opponent with the poisonous thorns on its jaw. However, sometimes it accidentally pricks itself…

species.name: Falco-ish
species.flavor: Falco-ish is a peace-loving, gentle monster, and probably isn't very popular with boys because of its odd coloring.

species.name: Fairy Hopper
species.flavor: It can jump a little higher than other Hoppers.

species.name: End-Bringer
species.flavor: This mechanical monster's soul has been infused by Joker.

species.name: Enki
species.flavor: There once was a country that was at war with [[Tochika]]. Enki is said to be the armor used in that country, feared because it is cursed.

species.name: Eye Fan
species.flavor: As a big fan of Suezo, he has become quite a monster.

species.name: Evil Hare
species.flavor: Though born of evil descent, he can be changed.

species.name: Ellyllon
species.flavor: Ellyllon is a kind-hearted monster whose favorite food is kinko. Try searching near some kinko — you’re sure to find its home there.

species.name: Eye Worm
species.flavor: His 4 different eyes can scare an opponent silly.

species.name: Express Worm
species.flavor: None can compete with its speed as long as it is on its line.

species.name: Fairy Saurian
species.flavor: We can ride on its back because it has no wings on its back.

species.name: Fair Lessie
species.flavor: Its glossy sheen is second to none. Apparently, wealthy breeders compete to raise one so they can show it off as a status symbol.

species.name: Edgehog
species.flavor: This monster can be very violent. Hence, he must be bred.

species.name: Eega
species.flavor: This eerie eel-shaped monster often squeals with laughter, though it too can't seem to figure out what's so funny.

species.name: Eren
species.flavor: It looks exactly like '''Eren''' when he transforms into a titan. It has a reckless side, and apparently some Breeders cannot handle them at all.

species.name: Escanor
species.flavor: It is incredibly muscular and possesses immense strength. However, because it is very arrogant, their Breeders have no end to their struggles.

species.name: Fantuger
species.flavor: A strange fairy that came from the land of [[Chuka]]. Some maniacs really love this monster. It is looking for a particular scroll...

species.name: Fukazo
species.flavor: Fukazo is often mistaken for a [[shark]], and this makes it angry. And when it's angry, it's far scarier than a measly shark!

species.name: Float
species.flavor: The cherry attached to its head is actually a special tactile sensor that reacts to changes in atmospheric pressure. Its weather predictions make it a valuable monster.

species.name: Flazer
species.flavor: The Flazer's skin grows thick to protect it from the severe heat of volcanoes. Its devastatingly sharp horns go well with its ferocious personality.

species.name: Fay (Pixie)
species.flavor: I wonder what misery those dark eyes have seen? It's said Fay has been through such sadness that the tears have dyed the area around its eyes black...

species.name: Fang
species.flavor: The most ferocious and dangerous of all Zans. (Maybe it's because of the curse a white weasel once put on it?) Beware of the Blade on a moonlit night!

species.name: Freebird
species.flavor: The wings on the Freebird's head stand for its youth and freedom. It spreads its wings and heads into a bright tomorrow. Nobody can fetter the Freebird.

species.name: Flamingo
species.flavor: The only female Raiden and a dedicated martial artist, she flies through the sky as if swimming and displays her magnificent battle skills. (A bit stubborn, though.)

species.name: Funbaba
species.flavor: The Funbaba, always sleepy looking, really hates conflict. But when it comes to food, it can throw big temper tantrums and thrash around. Quite a handful.

species.name: Falcolan
species.flavor: The Falcolan guards over the skies. It's rather aloof, but when it's really needed, it comes flying up at Mach speed.

species.name: Fire Gear
species.flavor: Pierces opponents with burning scissors. Although rare in Arrowheads, the reliable Fire Gear is water-averse.

species.name: Wall Mimic
species.flavor: A brat who is able to change his appearance into a fence.

species.name: Flame Jell
species.flavor: This is a monster made from a slimy material that looks like scales in pattern form. There are many mysteries surrounding this monster, but its firm body holds high potential in battles.

species.name: Ferious
species.flavor: It has the upper body of a Pixie and the lower body of a horse.

species.name: Fukazukin
species.flavor: Its shape came to resemble a shark after it adapted to the marine environment. It also need not worry about getting eaten by a shark this way...

species.name: Flasher
species.flavor: It is said to make its body shine to blind its foes before attacking, and that is supposedly how it got its name.

species.name: Fur Dragon
species.flavor: The fur of the Fur Dragon is extremely durable and very warm, making it especially popular with mothers.

species.name: FeaterGold
species.flavor: A sacred monster whose entire body is covered in golden scales. Its radiance is clearly on a completely different level from that of other Dragons.

species.name: Francois
species.flavor: A very high-end, luxury Ducken. A toy company produced it as a commemorative model, sparing no expense.

species.name: Frozen Gaboo
species.flavor: Its body temperature is always kept low even during summer.

species.name: Frog Hopper
species.flavor: It likes to play battle games with kids and be mischievous.

species.name: Fanged Mask
species.flavor: Wears [[Sapphire (Item)|an item]] which was made special by the Shrine Master.

species.name: Franken
species.flavor: An old monster brought to life with the power of electricity. By some kind of chance, it obtained a soul and started to move on its own.

species.name: Forestra
species.flavor: The ancient White Knight. Its sword has the magic power of repelling evil. Many have witnessed it sitting quietly in the woods.

species.name: Forti Knight
species.flavor: In order to become stronger, it has modified its own body, casting everything else aside in pursuit of [[power|strength]] alone. Its fierce determination is unmatched.

species.name: Flare Death
species.flavor: A descendant of a dragon has turned into an atrocious Joker.

species.name: Fire Joker
species.flavor: Fire Joker is wrapped in sacred flames, and is able to work miracles. It may look frightening, but is actually quite brave and surprisingly dependable.

species.name: Faylay
species.flavor: Its speed is certainly worth being called the embodiment of the wind. The air turns into a sharp blade as it runs through in top speed. It is not the monster you want on the wrong side.

species.name: Flower Worm
species.flavor: This TV star has been in plenty of commercials.

species.name: Folkes
species.flavor: The most noticeable feature of the Folkes are its large ears. These ears not only distinguish sounds well but are also used to adjust its body temperature.

species.name: Fenril
species.flavor: It is said this monster once fought with the [[Ragnarok|legendary Dragon]], but we don't know for sure. The scar on its forehead is rumored to be from that battle.

species.name: Jelly Hound
species.flavor: His 'cool' look makes him a hit when things get hot.

species.name: Kerorin
species.flavor: On rainy days Kerorin plays outside then comes inside soaking wet. Some say that Kerorin causes the rain to pour.

species.name: Flower
species.flavor: It has great talent in performance with its light and flexible movements like leaves being blown in the wind. Scientists are not so sure of its ability in battles however.

species.name: Fly Eye
species.flavor: A monster who tends to see everything as a blur.

species.name: Flaminden
species.flavor: A cute monster whose wooing dance charms those who lose themselves in its beauty. But when it comes to battles, it transforms itself into a combat type monster.

species.name: Fleece
species.flavor: This monster is good at winter sports and is often called 'Prince of the Snow Field.' However, the best thing about it is its ability to make a snowhouse.

species.name: Fly Plant
species.flavor: A spoiled brat who won't listen well to your orders.

species.name: Forward Golem
species.flavor: This monster has a strong will to rush into its goals.

species.name: Gamba
species.flavor: This tree lover has pointy ears and good [[Speed|quickness]].

species.name: GameProbot
species.flavor: Four-eyed Dragon' s older brother who would rather spend his days showing off his shiny metallic skin to strangers. Just don't use his chest as a mirror.

species.name: Geemo
species.flavor: This huge, peculiar creature is from the planet [[Onlyne]], and is something between a hippo, pig, and Baku. It hates the water on this planet, but has accepted the fact it can never return to its own.

species.name: Gelatine
species.flavor: Its flabby looking body is actually firmer than it appears.

species.name: Gadgeter G
species.flavor: The Gadgeter G is a steel war gadget told of in the legends of a [[Earth|distant planet]]. Gadgeter G defends the land again today with its mighty G power!

species.name: Garum
species.flavor: Galum's fur repels water, so it never really gets wet. That's why it can move so swiftly underwater.

species.name: Guy
species.flavor: This monster has the fastest airspeed. They say it learned how to fight in midair from a falcon living in the woods.

species.name: Gattcharin
species.flavor: With all the funny quirks of the Ducken, the GattchaRin accidentally breaks everything around it. But when it apologizes so sadly, all you can do is forgive it.

species.name: Gargoyle
species.flavor: Betrayed by humans, the Gargoyle sold its soul to a demon. For the power it received, it lost the ability to smile. It wishes it could trust people again.

species.name: Galloptan
species.flavor: Galloptan's dream for the future is to be a G1 jockey. It does image training every single day without fail. (It just looks like it's playing horsey, though.)

species.name: Futurity
species.flavor: Its looks may be what humans look like in the future.

species.name: Galeant
species.flavor: A crimson body and a fiery spirit. No matter the enemy, it will continue to fight with no fear. With its kabuto beetle-like horn, it will pierce through evil.

species.name: Gekko
species.flavor: The crescent moon on its forehead is a sign of justice. Whomever and wherever it is, everyone knows this monster is a hero.

species.name: Geisha
species.flavor: Even though it appears to be lazy, it does work very hard.

species.name: Gallop
species.flavor: A regular thoroughbred who has a lot of potential.

species.name: Gariel
species.flavor: He happens to have the most [[intelligence]] of the dragons.

species.name: Gate-Keeper
species.flavor: It is said that somewhere in this world there is an [[Warp Gate|entrance to another world]]. Legend says that it stands guard over that gate.

species.name: Gaboo Soldier
species.flavor: This monster is hot blooded, but often makes careless mistakes.

species.name: Galirous
species.flavor: Wears an item which has a special break-proof coating.

species.name: Gali-ish
species.flavor: After suffering through 1,000 years of sun basking to become a [[Gali]], it realized the sun screen it used was untested, turning it this odd bluish color.

species.name: Gamer
species.flavor: He is a regular sportsman who likes to fight rough.

species.name: Gaia (Henger)
species.flavor: This unlucky one is cursed by the wicked soul of Golem.

species.name: Garlant
species.flavor: It is considered to be a phantom monster in the [[FIMBA]] area.

species.name: Garuda
species.flavor: It is said that the legendary general [[Garuda (Character)|Garuda]] used to wear it.

species.name: Galooda
species.flavor: A quick and agile warrior with a soul as hot as the desert sun. It used to fly freely in the air.

species.name: Galaxy
species.flavor: This monster relates to the [[Sky]] monster in the [[FIMBA]] area.

species.name: Gappaya
species.flavor: It is rumored that the third eye on its forehead emits a beam to turn a liar into stone. But it is only a rumor, so breeders feel safe about training it.

species.name: Gangster
species.flavor: A powerful guy who totes an Uzi machine gun in hand.

species.name: Gaia (Xenon)
species.flavor: It is named after one of the primordial gods. Its body color is strongly influenced by its Centaur DNA and it retains the great cavalry sense, even though it only has two legs.

species.name: Gecko (Worm)
species.flavor: He keeps his body heat by being covered in scales.

species.name: Furred Wall
species.flavor: Make sure to take good care of his fur and keep fleas off.

species.name: Galion
species.flavor: May be better off being being a monster reborn instead.

species.name: Galberra
species.flavor: A happy monster born where varicolored flowers bloom. The scent must have resulted in some sort of monster therapy...

species.name: Sumocchi
species.flavor: He has mastered the Eastern art of wrestling called 'Sumo.' He retired the rank of Yokozuna (champion), and now entered the arena of Monster Battles!!

species.name: Gawain (Joker)
species.flavor: A unique-looking monster whose entire body is covered in armor. It is said to possess immense [[power]], and those who face it on the battlefield are struck with terror.

species.name: Gizumocchi
species.flavor: The Gizumocchi has a very strong sense of justice and hates wrongdoing. But it also loves to play in the sand. Maybe it's just a big kid after all.

species.name: General Death
species.flavor: This cruel and vicious general is said to have come from outer space. It lives for combat, and only respects those of equal or greater rank than itself.

species.name: Gingie
species.flavor: The Gingie looks different from other monsters. It seems scary, but it's as gentle as it is strong. It loves to be called 'The Ginster!' Right, Ginster?

species.name: Gobi
species.flavor: It is said that this monster was a weapon for the ancient war.

species.name: GigaBio
species.flavor: The outstanding features of the Giga Bio are its purple body and large fangs. Kids often start crying when they see it, but it really only wants to play...

species.name: Gentle Mocchi
species.flavor: It is a phantom monster and only a skillful and lucky trainer can get it.

species.name: Glacier
species.flavor: Its helmet is shaped like a Tiger's figure.

species.name: Genocider
species.flavor: It is said that a curse has been put upon this armor.

species.name: Ghars
