species.flavor: Some of its parts are transparent, made of a gas-like substance. (That's why it's so good at evading.) Born of a young boy's dream, nobody knows what it really is.

species.name: Genkitchi
species.flavor: A very cheerful monster.

species.name: Giliant
species.flavor: A hot-blooded monster that dreams of being a hero one day, it's the only Gitan with a fair and just heart. His favorite expression is 'Do a good thing every day.'

species.name: Gilolitan
species.flavor: It carries magical sand that can put people to sleep. But every now and then, it accidentally sprinkles the sand on itself and ends up feeling very tired...

species.name: Girtab
species.flavor: Girtab, which symbolizes death, is considered inauspicious. Only those who can overcome superstition have the qualifications to raise it.

species.name: Noble Jell
species.flavor: He trains all the time to be considered legendary.

species.name: Goku
species.flavor: The bushy-eyebrowed Goku once went on a big adventure carrying a strange and mysterious weapon. The band around its head reminds it of those adventure days.

species.name: Gillon
species.flavor: With its spiky, unruly hair and selfish attitude, Gillon is rough around the edges in every way. Yet that very immaturity is also part of its charm.

species.name: Gibberer
species.flavor: His mean acts make him less than popular among others.

species.name: Gold Dust
species.flavor: It seems to be decadent, but it is actually a hard worker.

species.name: Gigapint
species.flavor: It is quiet and patient. Its body of gel is very flexible.

species.name: Gidras
species.flavor: This dragon has the mysterious power of [[Metalner]].

species.name: Gespenst
species.flavor: Wears a silver mask and wields a red-hot sickle. Those monsters cut by its weapon are engulfed in flames and end up being consumed.

species.name: Glitter
species.flavor: It continues to slash at opponents as if devouring them. Although many Breeders look on them with disdain, its power is undeniable.

species.name: Gigalon
species.flavor: It was believed the ocean had eyes until it was discovered.

species.name: Gold Piroro
species.flavor: Gold Piroro is known as the genius performance monster. Its performance moves anyone who comes by to watch, and generally acknowledged to be a genius who mesmerizes spectators even in battle.

species.name: Gold Suezo
species.flavor: This is a very rare monster, for its body is the color gold.

species.name: Sampler
species.flavor: Noble people love this guy and his flashy style.

species.name: Gogmagog
species.flavor: It possesses such incredible power that it can sink even a large ship with a single strike. It attacks anything that comes near, without exception!

species.name: Gobi Marine
species.flavor: Gobi Marine, the legendary weapon. If it had ever been used, the creatures of the sea would surely have been wiped out completely.

species.name: Geo
species.flavor: Said to be the guardian deity of the earth, there is even a legend that its fists can cause earthquakes.

species.name: GoroNya
species.flavor: The breeder's most popular monsters of [[Mew]] with a sub-type of [[Dolan]]. I think you have a breeder and are fine, Dolan derived breeders have a monster of the few I'm afraid yet? I did the

species.name: RedBurn
species.flavor: A fighter who uses its body to protect the peace of the world. This makes it the object of admiration for the smaller monsters.

species.name: Green Suezo
species.flavor: More of a sun bather than a fighter. He's easy to breed.

species.name: Granity
species.flavor: Looks like a human with wings and a tail.

species.name: GrapaDuck
species.flavor: Grapen's dream is to fill battle arenas to capacity. It’s a natural-born entertainer!

species.name: Guan-Yu Duck
species.flavor: This rowdy monster just eats or breaks everything. It goes through its opponents easily. As it has swords for hands, it sometimes cuts off its own beard

species.name: Gontar
species.flavor: It is curious and wants to accept all kinds of challenges.

species.name: Goldie (Durahan)
species.flavor: Clad in magnificent golden armor, it would rather not dirty or damage it if not necessary.

species.name: Grapie
species.flavor: Influenced by the [[Naga]], it has decided to try acting a little rebellious. However, since it's naturally so well-behaved, it's having a hard time pulling it off.

species.name: Griffonite
species.flavor: Basically, it's a Raiden, but top martial arts training has been passed down through its blood. It's never taken off its armor once in its life.

species.name: Grindink
species.flavor: The faces on its stomach and tail have minds of their own and sometimes get into arguments. In the end, it's always the face on the tail that settles things.

species.name: Graspecter
species.flavor: The central characteristic of a grasshopper is hopping and jumping around in grassy fields. Jumping around seems to be fun!

species.name: Goro Goro
species.flavor: Despite its thunder-like roar and abundance of lightning techniques, it actually has only a little bit of static with its body. Be especially careful when petting it during the winter.

species.name: Grasbie
species.flavor: Grasbie is said to be faster when it jumps than when it runs. If you look at those short legs, you might understand.

species.name: Gooaall!
species.flavor: This monster is a big time fan of the soccer sport.

species.name: Grape
species.flavor: A Dino-Naga mix with high [[Power]] and low [[Intelligence]].

species.name: Grupus
species.flavor: Grupus was born when moss grew on a Dragon hibernating underground. It can photosynthesize, so it can live for many days without eating.

species.name: Wild Hare
species.flavor: This guy is very happy with his thick eye brows.

species.name: Gremlin
species.flavor: A rare type of monster with a talent for tinkering with mechanical devices. It's very [[Intelligence|intelligent]], but it uses those skills to pull pranks, making it quite a troublesome rascal.

species.name: Grim Reaper
species.flavor: A KARAKURI-Combination type Tokobot. At one look the Reaper seems adorable, but shows its true appearance when defeating its enemies. The scythe is not to be underestimated.

species.name: Grasster
species.flavor: The ancient battlefields have become its home. No one maintains [[Plains of Aspia|these grasslands]], and yet they are neatly trimmed...because there is someone who does it.

species.name: Leaf Hare
species.flavor: It is a real freedom-fighter. Look at his tattoo.

species.name: Gordish
species.flavor: This monster seems to take a philosophical view of life.

species.name: Grilief
species.flavor: The leaf is for camouflage reasons. Its hiding ability is so great that even their Breeders can't find them.

species.name: Gooji
species.flavor: With its huge horn, it can even sink a large ship.

species.name: Gramper
species.flavor: It was born with that great looking beard, which can be combined with the horn on its head to see things far, far away.

species.name: Gray Wolf
species.flavor: He has a beautiful coat of silver fur. Howls at night.

species.name: Griphyon
species.flavor: This bird is revered as the King of the Sands, but it is really rather modest. It must be quietly training somewhere in the desert right now...

species.name: Grandie
species.flavor: It slow dances to the rhythm of darkness. But those very movements are the perfected form of a dance stripped of all unnecessary motion.

species.name: Gorenu
species.flavor: A subspecies of Korunu distinguished by its crystallized horns. Like Korunu, it is normally gentle and mild-mannered, and is especially popular with children.

species.name: Gray Mew
species.flavor: It is rumored that it has a dagger under his sleeves, despite its innocent look. Don't get too close and keep your guard up, as it is said to use its sharp claws to launch a surprise attack.

species.name: Golem-ish
species.flavor: Golem-ish is the shyest of all Golem types, and hates to be stared at. When hiding, its rock body was altered, but it doesn't really mind at all.

species.name: Gunbitt
species.flavor: An unusual Hare said to have come from the moon. Its favorite thing is pounding rice for mochi, so it's always happily pounding away.

species.name: Harlequin
species.flavor: It inflicts damage to its enemies taking advantage of its agility and light footwork. The mysterious poker face that conceals its intentions is also said to be the secret of its strength.

species.name: Hachiro
species.flavor: It is more intelligent than people think it is.

species.name: Hanaro
species.flavor: Its big flower makes it very popular with young women. It's said to have a very fresh smell which has a relaxing effect.

species.name: Hell Pierrot
species.flavor: Though it is a descendant from Joker, it cannot turn into a complete fiend.

species.name: Helm Hound
species.flavor: A scientist once wondered if this monster wouldn't be just another dog if it didn't have its shell. He tried valiantly to remove it but failed miserably.

species.name: HakTak
species.flavor: The HakTak has a Naga's temperament and a Ripper's aloofness. It can see right into its opponent's soul. It's hard to raise but it can be a reliable partner.

species.name: GunBits
species.flavor: Try to imagine an entire army of GunBits. (Too overwhelming to think about?) If you train it right, the GunBits will be a mighty ally!

species.name: Halloween
species.flavor: It has a pumpkin over its head from the time it's born so even it has never seen its own face. Sometimes you can see its eyes through the holes, and they're pretty cute.

species.name: Gyoruna
species.flavor: Covered in hard scales, the Gyoruna can even swim through magma unscathed. Because it has such a ferocious temperament, it's pretty hard to break it in.

species.name: Heel Ow
species.flavor: Looks and personality befit its name. When raising a hero, that time is now!

species.name: Harken
species.flavor: In its desire for strength, it endlessly punches rocks everyday. Its well-trained punch will destroy any obstacle.

species.name: Gyororo
species.flavor: When the fighting spirit that has entered the eye exert strong spill so big highlight features, usually has a lot of charm to your eyes.

species.name: Gurlok
species.flavor: Who loves the ''Official US PlayStation Magazine''? Gurlok! He gets so much snazzy info from OPM that he's had a tattoo proclaiming his love for the mag inked onto his belly.

species.name: Hagi Dragon
species.flavor: More than anything else, what catches the eye are its beautiful wings. They are not only beautiful, but also light and incredibly strong, making them extremely valuable.

species.name: Gullken
species.flavor: A cool [[seagull]] that travels from sea to sea. However, according to some, it may simply be restless.

species.name: Happy Mask
species.flavor: Its bright expression will make you forget about your worries.

species.name: Heimdall
species.flavor: It is said to stand between this world and the [[Land of Chaos]]. If the demons ever invade, it is prepared to be the first to face them.

species.name: Hell Heart
species.flavor: According to legend, it was an atrocious monster.

species.name: Pickle
species.flavor: Normally, it's very calm and gentle, but on nights lit by the full moon, it undergoes a dramatic transformation! It becomes an incredibly ferocious monster!

species.name: Hell Lord
species.flavor: From the deepest depths of darkness came a murderer. Both his mask and cloak are stained red -- it is the blood splatter of his opponents.

species.name: Hare-ish
species.flavor: Once a rabbit was given prohibited pet food by its owner, and was turned into Hare-ish as a result. Although rejected by its owner, it can't forget him and continues to search for him.

species.name: Hariluro
species.flavor: A monster as cute as a stuffed toy. Since it is rare outside of [[Age]], tourists come just to hold and cuddle it.

species.name: Haman
species.flavor: A precious species that possesses a beautiful white body. In the eastern lands, it is praised as an agent of God, and is believed to bring luck and swipe away evil.

species.name: Haze
species.flavor: Not only its cat-like claws, but also the sharp blades on its back can slice through anything. The way it toys with its prey before finishing it off sends chills down the spine of anyone watching.

species.name: Han
species.flavor: The slender body and the beautiful combat style has many fans. It is only to be trained to see that it does live up to its expectations.

species.name: Hare Hound
species.flavor: His big, dark eyes mesmerize one into a relaxing state.

species.name: HawkClaw
species.flavor: Its cooing is said to be the cutest among the Piroro species. There are breeders who train this monster because it wants to hear it coo, but beware as it does so from very early in the morning.

species.name: Hare Plant
species.flavor: He's so fast sometimes that he can make himself dizzy.

species.name: Gym Bajarl
species.flavor: Great personality; can't hate it no matter what. Has a mysterious past.

species.name: Haukutoriki
species.flavor: A polite and serious monster with a dignified demeanor that gives off the feeling of a veteran warrior.

species.name: Hamunofuji
species.flavor: A rare member of the Kawazumo species, this monster is covered in soft, fluffy fur. It has many admirers, who simply can't get enough of its delightfully round, chubby appearance.

species.name: Guren
species.flavor: A monster with a right arm that resembles a weapon called a Radiation Wave. True to its intimidating appearance, it is said to be very reliable on the battlefield.

species.name: Hao
species.flavor: Contrary to her gentle, smiling expression, her personality is extremely cruel. At times, she acts as if she can see right through you. Even her jokes should never be taken lightly...

species.name: Haniel
species.flavor: Stylish and incredibly pretentious for one of the Ark species, it transforms into a handsome young man who can charm many women. It feels competitive toward those who are more handsome than him.

species.name: Hare Claus
species.flavor: Among the [[Santa]]s, this monster has the most delivery experience and only the purest of hearts will transform into this monster. The gifts that it delivers are still the same, though, so don't be disappointed.

species.name: Hornie
species.flavor: Be weary of his sharp horn that can injure a [[breeder]].

species.name: Honey (Hare)
species.flavor: Honey is famous for its cute hips and round ears. No matter how hard it flaps its wings, it can only fly a couple inches at most.

species.name: Hip Mew
species.flavor: Hey, rock 'n' roll, baby! Me and my rockin' friends will show you our cool moves on the dance floor. And when it comes to battle, I'm at the top of the charts!

species.name: Higante
species.flavor: It has an abundant knowledge, but is not good at applying it.

species.name: HippopoChaos
species.flavor: It's descended from a species that knows the ways of the wind but it seems to have forgotten everything. Now it only knows the ways of the afternoon nap.

species.name: Hermes
species.flavor: It is said to be equipped with legendary footwear that allows it to run through the sky.

species.name: Homura
species.flavor: Homura's origin of the name comes from gathering flames. When its crimson body starts to enflame, it will burn everything in its vicinity without a shadow left to be seen.

species.name: Hibis
species.flavor: The flower on its tail grows bigger as Hibis gets older. Perfumes created from this flower are a special product made solely in Kalaragi.

species.name: HighRoller
species.flavor: The red-bodied Highroller can't stop once it starts running. Some say it's three times as fast as the regular Rhinoroller, but that hasn't been proven.

species.name: Husky Gill
species.flavor: The HuskyGill loves the cold ocean water. Because it's always right there when the floating ice comes in, everyone fondly calls it the 'Messenger of Winter.'

species.name: Hot Foot
species.flavor: An evolved monster who can get very cold at times.

species.name: Hicken
species.flavor: A passionate, hot-blooded fighter with a burning heart. However, its face doesn’t often convey that passion.

species.name: Heuy
species.flavor: You will be surprised to see it flying around in the air fast.

species.name: Henger-ish
species.flavor: This monster was sealed beneath the earth by an [[Pendant Ruins|ancient super civilization]]. Years of volcanic heat changed its metal to an odd color.

species.name: Highlander
species.flavor: An armor monster adapted to the snow. They say it used to be the soul of a warrior who died on a quest for a legendary place.

species.name: Herbert
species.flavor: A monster said to be the soul of a master swordsman with cat-like agility dwelling within his beloved suit of armor.

species.name: Hercules
species.flavor: It has excellent strength and a dull sword won't even scratch it.

species.name: Usaba (Suezo Sub)
species.flavor: If you don't discipline this monster, he'll become a brat.

species.name: Homunculus
species.flavor: An improved breed of Hare created by human hands. It is extremely [[intelligent]] and highly knowledgeable, but its [[Life|lifespan]] is very short.

species.name: Henger Doll
species.flavor: It is a doll of Henger with a wicked soul.

species.name: Heptameron
species.flavor: Its character is quiet, but it is brave when protecting animals.

species.name: Hound Saurian
species.flavor: It can run fast, so it is often used to deliver express mail.

species.name: Hotrod
species.flavor: This monster runs in the desert at night. It doesn't really mind that it can only run in straight lines. Its shiny mane is the symbol of a Zoom.

species.name: HowlZapper
species.flavor: The HowlZapper, with the characteristics of both the Tiger and Ripper, is said to be the fastest in the world. By the time the opponent hears it, it's too late.

species.name: Horowitz
species.flavor: It is entirely covered in jelly, and its softness is one of a kind. Its attacks take advantage of its flexibility and inflict painful damages on its opponents quickly.

species.name: Holstarin
species.flavor: People were curious about where this monster gets the milk it brings, so they finally decided to follow it, only to see something they shouldn't have.

species.name: Hohocto
species.flavor: This Octopee lives in trees. However, they are very bad at climbing, so once they fall out of a tree, they can't get back up again.

species.name: Hinatcho
species.flavor: Often mistaken for a Chuparo's chick, it has a spoiled and quiet personality. When bad things happen it hides itself in an empty eggshell, but it's yellow legs can still be seen.

species.name: Higanbana
species.flavor: A monster with a strong will, seen in its large eye. It has wing-like parts on its sides, but they are too small to fly.

species.name: Hypnos
species.flavor: When its green eyes glow, it is said to induce drowsiness in those who are watching. Sailors are always afraid of encountering Hypnos at sea.

species.name: Iblis
species.flavor: The Ark species can only stay transfigured for a very short time. Such inconvenience has created building resentment inside with no release, so this monster is seeking revenge on the [[Joker]] who created him.

species.name: Izuna
species.flavor: Only a few people have seen Izuna before. It is said this is because Izuna has mastered the martial art of Ninjutsu.

species.name: Jailkeeper
species.flavor: It was born as the guardian of an [[Promiass|island]] where criminals were imprisoned. With its sharp eyes, it never lets anyone escape.

species.name: Jaguarbeat
species.flavor: The Jaguar Beat looks similar to the [[Jagd Hound]], a Tiger and [[Worm]] mix, but this monster is really popular with kids. Jaguar Beats with glossy coats are rare.

species.name: Jackoranta
species.flavor: With its pumpkin head, it doesn't need an umbrella. It loves the rain! It gets lonely so it likes groups, and it gets really attached to its breeder.

species.name: Tobita
species.flavor: Inaba Hare may have a cute face, but it's surprisingly crafty and calculating. Unfortunately, it always says one thing too many, so even its carefully planned pranks often end up failing.

species.name: Jelaydon
species.flavor: With its sharp edges, its entire body is a weapon. That's why the Monster Association is always asking breeders to be careful. It's light despite its size.

species.name: Icebergy
species.flavor: It is a glutton, so ordinary people do not raise it.

species.name: Janne
species.flavor: It is brave but its heart is a little bit too delicate to defeat enemies.

species.name: Ironclaw
species.flavor: There are many Arrowheads, but among them, when it comes to just the scissors, nothing surpasses this one. It has the strongest attack [[power]].

species.name: Isis Guard
species.flavor: In the age of myth, it served to protect the [[Deities|gods]]. Because it had that role, its [[Defense|defensive power]] is absolutely overwhelming - it’s just that durable and sturdy.

species.name: Javelineer
species.flavor: Its fast charge attack is the selling point of the Javelineer. Even if it’s dodged, you'll end up in trouble...

species.name: Jaba
species.flavor: It is said that this monster was made to be used as an assassin.

species.name: Icy Jell
species.flavor: On a cold and frozen winter day, this guy will freeze.

species.name: Worm Jell
species.flavor: He has an odd pair of shiny green eyes that stare at you.

species.name: Jellnico
species.flavor: Shows kindness towards reds and fury towards blues. It is full of kindness life, but reveals its fury when it comes to battles. This large gap in personality is sure to surprise you.

species.name: Insebel
species.flavor: There are creepy rumors that this monster can be found in the cocoons made by the worms. Its battling abilities are highly regarded.

species.name: Ingarul
species.flavor: Ingarul is one of the most complete and refined in spirit amongst the Garu species. However, observation of his daily activities casts a doubt on that reputation.

species.name: Jaggernaut
species.flavor: Its carmine eyes show its wickedness.

species.name: Jaques
species.flavor: He has a strange flower growing from his head.

species.name: Jabberwock
species.flavor: The Jabberwock is known for its comical movements, like those of a clown. Despite that, its ferocity surpasses that of an ordinary Dragon.

species.name: Jelly Gaboo
species.flavor: It is similar to Jell, but it has no core like that of Jell.

species.name: JammHat
species.flavor: A robot covered entirely in flashy armor, still under development. It doesn't seem to act according to its programming.

species.name: Ice Candy
species.flavor: His face is well protected, but his body isn't.

species.name: Irabuya
species.flavor: Its smooth, scaly body divides Breeders. However, its ability in combat receives no complaint, and once you get used to it, it is rather cute.

species.name: Ibuki
species.flavor: Some believe it is a larval form of Zan, but its abilities surpass even those of Zan itself!

species.name: Jagd Hound
species.flavor: This unique guy has 4 eyes that help him see far and near.

species.name: Ivory Wall
species.flavor: His mask has the markings of an [[Deities|almighty god]].

species.name: Jack-in-the-Cho
species.flavor: When it finds a treasure chest, it slips inside and makes itself at home. It attacks anybody that opens the chest, so it's greatly feared by many adventurers.

species.name: Immelk
species.flavor: A monster who parallels Antero, though this monster is said to be more aggressive. Its appearance is somewhat enigmatic and its face resembles a jeweled visor or crown.

species.name: Isobe
species.flavor: Isobe was the most famous creature in Goat, until they found [[Octopee]]. Go Isobe! Show them you're still the best!

species.name: Ichigo
species.flavor: A monster that absolutely loves a [[Strawberry (Item)|certain fruit]]. Not only does it enjoy eating the fruit itself, but it also seems to spend all its time spreading the word so that everyone can discover how delicious it is.

species.name: Jelline
species.flavor: This [[Jell]] completely transformed in the relentless pursuit of cuteness. Because it is good at getting its way and is confident in its appearance, occasionally it will be flirty in order to ask for things.

species.name: Melloncho
species.flavor: It appears in the hot months of summer. All it wants to do is eat [[watermelon]] all season. They say it lives out the winter underground, but few have ever seen it.

species.name: Kapukkoro
species.flavor: People say that watching Kapukkoro will cure colds and other common ailments. Kapukkoro do not appreciate this kind of superstition.

species.name: Rock Dragon
species.flavor: He's shy, but has the most [[Power]] of all the Dragons.

species.name: King-Tut Duck
species.flavor: For some reason, Karakkung is afraid of triangles. When it sees one, it starts meditating. I wonder why?

species.name: Jungler
species.flavor: He enjoys a camouflage disguise to confuse foes.

species.name: Kagura
species.flavor: Nobody knows whether it fell from heaven or came up out of the earth. Everybody's hero, the Kagura travels all over the world, hating the sin but loving the sinner.

species.name: Skyhorn
species.flavor: Not only is it fast, but its sky-blue color lets it blend in with its surroundings in the water or air. With its low body temperature, it loves to sunbathe.

species.name: Jet
species.flavor: It aims to be a cool villain, and uses its natural [[speed]] to cause mischief. Even its failures happen at record-breaking speed!

species.name: Karma
species.flavor: Good deeds shall be rewarded, and bad deeds shall be punished. People today often forget such common sense, but Karma is here to help them remember.

species.name: Kakao
species.flavor: Thanks to the heat of the jungle, Kakao is very easy-going. On a moonlit night, you might be able to see its Jell Dance, though you'll lose [[Guts]] Points.

species.name: Justin
species.flavor: Just like its name, its personality is burning with justice. But to some people it’s a little bit too hot. Raise them in moderation.

species.name: Junior
species.flavor: The name 'Junior' may not sound like much, but this monster is a highly-skilled assassin. It trains on a daily basis to stay on top of the 'food chain' as it says.

species.name: Kanabron
species.flavor: Its horns are very good, but its claws are its main weapon. The sharp claws are known as 'Iron Claws,' and you would not want it on your bad side. Things would get ugly.

species.name: Jock
species.flavor: Jock is training hard to become the ultimate athlete. It thinks the main secret to greatness is spinning in circles. Silly? Yes. But it's actually kind of working so... props to the Jock.

species.name: Joker-ish
species.flavor: When a Joker decided to change its evil ways and live among humans, it was stripped of its evil powers and reborn as Joker-ish.

species.name: Juggler
species.flavor: It uses the scythe like an extension of its own body. It plays with the lives of other monsters as if they were toys.

species.name: Jiro
species.flavor: This monster can curl up into a highly armored ball. But if the wind blows when it's like this, it will be rolling around all over the place.

species.name: Jellysaurus
species.flavor: Its body beaming with the sunlight reflected off the surface of the sea as it's swimming through the ocean is a beautiful sight. Many people have visited to look at such monster.

species.name: Kaduka
species.flavor: This one's a born fighter. Has high [[Intelligence]] and [[Power]].

species.name: Jerod
species.flavor: May look scary but is actually very nice and kind-hearted.

species.name: Jelly Worm
species.flavor: His flabby appearance makes him so lovable.

species.name: Jelly Saurian
species.flavor: Its body is made up gel and can be a comfortable type of cushion.

species.name: Kamui
species.flavor: It escaped being executed for killing humans.

species.name: Kablo
species.flavor: Wait under the big tree in the forest and cover it with honey. It might be lured by the smell of honey and come wondering about. Very popular among kids who like insects.

species.name: Jojo
species.flavor: Panko is an unconventional dresser and loves to travel. It might be coming to your town soon!

species.name: Jiji
species.flavor: A slightly mature monster with a heart as hot as fire and a mind as cool as snow.

species.name: Jura Wall
species.flavor: This hot-head can be a little short with his temper.

species.name: Jungle Plum
species.flavor: Its dance is so amazing that toys were made to mimic it. I used to have one growing up.

species.name: Karaoke
species.flavor: This monster tries to mimic all of the top singers.

species.name: Kaio
species.flavor: It is said this Golem is modeled after a Sea God in a fairy tale. This is the only Golem not afraid of water.

species.name: Kacho Fugetsu
species.flavor: A monster who seems gentle and demure. However, she enjoys seeing men attracted to her.

species.name: Kagamimochi
species.flavor: The Kagami mochi ornament, created based on the legend that good fortune will come to a household that contains one, is popular on New Years Eve in many homes.

species.name: Kappachi
species.flavor: A mysterious Mocchi who lives in [[Nurse Wetlands|a certain region]]. But there is one thing that is known about it - it can't swim! Apparently, it's just too heavy.

species.name: Kitten
species.flavor: A musical based on Kitten's life has played a long run.

species.name: Kirin (Zuum)
species.flavor: This monster was once a decorative ornament at a shrine, but one day it came to life and ran away. Now it's worshipped as a god in some [[Eastern Continent|eastern provinces]].

species.name: Kero
species.flavor: Kero adapted to a water environment differently than [[Tortboy]]. It is said it sometimes sings a song to bring rain.

species.name: Kasumi
species.flavor: Its breasts tend to get more attention than its battles.

species.name: KoroBall
species.flavor: The Korottama and the Puchi Otome are rivals. So far the record stands at 2-2. The Korottama won the Eating Contest and the 'Let's Do Acrobatics' championship.

species.name: KoroHelmets
species.flavor: KoroHelmets hurt each other with their spikes but that's how they really get to trust each other. They rush forward in perfect formation and then it's...touchdown!

species.name: KoroKoroller
species.flavor: Just like its name, the KoroKoroller just rolls along, and it always drives safely. Its red nose warns it when it starts going too fast.

species.name: Koroncho
species.flavor: A monster shrouded in mystery, nobody knows what it really is. They say it often appears on beautiful, starry nights. Maybe it came from outer space?

species.name: Kijimuna
species.flavor: Though it carries Octopee’s bloodline, it lives deep in the forest. It is skilled at fishing, so if you go fishing with it, you’re always guaranteed a big catch!

species.name: King Ape
species.flavor: This monster is feared as the dominator of the [[Parepare Jungle]].

species.name: Kobu
species.flavor: They say at the top of its head you can find the legendary

species.name: KautRoarKaut
species.flavor: It is used as a means of transportation by some people.

species.name: Korodango
species.flavor: If you poke this monster, it curls up to protect itself. Although it could probably move faster in that shape, it never does. Maybe it hurts to roll?

species.name: Koronit
species.flavor: When the weather becomes cold, its fur becomes thicker. You can tell which region this monster is from by looking at the thickness of its fur.

species.name: Kujata
species.flavor: This mysterious Dragon is said to have come from the other side of the moon, though that is not really true. It has a bad temper and is hard to train.

species.name: Kokken
species.flavor: A proud Ducken, awakened to the spirit of chivalry, but it has yet to gain true composure.

species.name: Kinken
species.flavor: A Ducken that evolved after being attacked by a cat and studying its power! However, it still doesn’t like cats.

species.name: Kelmadics
species.flavor: This stone armor is too heavy for normal people to wear.

species.name: Warrior Z
species.flavor: This name means that no one can equal it.

species.name: Krsnik
species.flavor: A monster whose soul has taken up residence within the armor of a divine knight. Its sacred power repels all attacks.

species.name: Knight Niton
species.flavor: Its shell is the hardest of all the Niton species.

species.name: Kiki
species.flavor: Mischievous Kiki likes to jump from tree to tree and drop nuts on people walking below. Watch out!

species.name: Kesshoka
species.flavor: When the wind blows, its beautiful song can be heard. The melody makes you sleepy and sometimes you get lost.

species.name: Kueruno
species.flavor: A monster that inhabits cold regions, it possesses skin hardened into an armor-like, keratinized hide. It is highly resistant to cold but does not tolerate heat well. Compared with Korunu, it is much more curious and becomes accustomed to people more easily. However, because it is also more active, it is more prone to aggressive behavior.

species.name: Koloro
species.flavor: Koloro has lived in Kalaragi for a long, long time. Every year at the famous [[Koloro Festival]], you can see the Koloro Dance. It's fun.

species.name: Konta
species.flavor: Konta thinks it can do anything with just a piece of a leaf. It often tries to use the leaf as money and gets in trouble for it.

species.name: Koinobori
species.flavor: The patterns on its body are so beautiful that they captivate anyone. In a certain region, there is an annual event where this monster makes an appearance, and it seems to be popular with children.

species.name: Ragnarok
species.flavor: A dark soul that has been accused of mass destruction.

species.name: LaMew
species.flavor: A cute and fluffy breed of Mew, popular with girls. Popular as a healing monster with a quiet personality.

species.name: LaRock
species.flavor: Though it looks like a light and fluffy mass of cotton, it in fact has considerable weight and hardness. This monster is a top-class fighter with lots of [[power]] despite its gentle personality.

species.name: MikMew
species.flavor: Always full of energy, it's constantly running. Its dream is to someday be the star of the battle world! It plans to eat, sleep and fight a lot to get strong.

species.name: Lava Lessie
species.flavor: Inside a body that can stand up to lava, it keeps a cool, level head. A monster you can rely on, it can always make a calm decision no matter how tough things get!

species.name: Lafreshitan
species.flavor: The Lafreshitan loves sunshine. It's always happiest when it's sunbathing, lapping up the nectar from the flower on its head.

species.name: Lepus
species.flavor: Her long ears don't mean that she'll listen well.

species.name: Kung-Fu Pixie
species.flavor: An unusual one in the Pixie species that is trying to master the martial arts, but it's having trouble mastering the techniques.

species.name: Landshark
species.flavor: Its super-strong scissors have destructive power comparable to a [[Shark]]’s jaw. If you get caught in them, you won’t survive!

species.name: Land-Diver
species.flavor: Its drills spin fast and crush rocks. It digs underground freely, just like swimming underwater.

species.name: Lacoon
species.flavor: Lacoon is the manager of the forest. It uses the pincers on its head to cut back useless branches.

species.name: Leon (Baku)
species.flavor: 'Sleeping Lion' is the perfect phrase to describe Leon, because it is asleep just about all the time. Maybe a little bit too much.

species.name: Kung-Fu Dragon
species.flavor: 'I have never seen Kung-Fu get hit by an enemy,' says a Breeder that trained one. (and she's not lying!)

species.name: Lekken
species.flavor: It has an honest, obedient personality and listens well to its Breeder. However, it only listens — it doesn’t actually follow through with anything.

species.name: Leoken
species.flavor: A Ducken that has acquired an innocent heart. Its curiosity is so strong that it sometimes ends up dismantling its own body.

species.name: Kuma
species.flavor: He's a monster who loves the old-fashioned way of life.

species.name: Kyuza
species.flavor: This is the most common type of Henger that was manufactured. Different color versions and custom types can also be seen.

species.name: Tropical Dog
species.flavor: He is covered in leaves to help him grow. Unpopular.

species.name: Kung-Fu Hare
species.flavor: It trains daily to master the ancient art of kung fu.

species.name: Kuro
species.flavor: He has the classic dream of becoming a superhero.

species.name: Kuririn
species.flavor: When you see Kuririn in the woods, put out your fires. If Kuririn catches fire, it will explode.

species.name: Kurincho
species.flavor: This monster was found under a huge chestnut tree. Initially, the monster still had burrs and many Breeders were hurt.

species.name: Lapislatel
species.flavor: Called the 'Desert Castle,' this Golem has high [[defense]]. When traveling in the desert, Breeders sometimes bring one instead of a tent.

species.name: Lemlaria
species.flavor: This golden Golem has been blessed by the mysterious powers of the deep forest. It looks golden because of this magical blessing.

species.name: Kusazumo
species.flavor: A monster that came from the [[Refirn Islands|southern islands]] to compete in a foreign sport. Its cheerful personality has made it quite popular, but some say its fighting style is too straightforward and predictable to be exciting.

species.name: Lancelot
species.flavor: A monster that carries the dignity of a knight. On the battlefield, it stands tall and proud. It will show you in the way that it fights.

species.name: Machu Picchu
species.flavor: Looks pretty high-tech but it's only a wind-up toy. It has a hard time getting its gears to line up right. It once tried out for a movie but was rejected.

species.name: Lidee
species.flavor: Hold on tightly when you get on this fella. He's very fast.

species.name: Lilim
species.flavor: It can be best described as a little witch.

species.name: LionKoro
species.flavor: The LionKoro has all the strength of a lion but comes in a compact size. Act now and get all three at a bargain price! What a deal! Wanna buy a set?

species.name: Log-Sawer
species.flavor: Its body is made out of solid oak and is not soft but inflammable.

species.name: Lobearta
species.flavor: Maid by day, skilled fighter by night. This creature was planning to quit its day job, but grew to love it so much that it hasn't been easy.

species.name: Love-Seeker
species.flavor: It is a Metalner combined with a Pixie to understand 'love.'

species.name: Liveriz
species.flavor: Liveriz is getting more and more popular with women for its angel-like fluff and lovely smile. It doesn't really like to be considered the Beata that's a little too peaceful.

species.name: Lionel
species.flavor: Its fangs, polished every day without fail, are strong enough to crush even rock! Showing them is usually enough to make most foes turn tail and run.

species.name: Liorosa
species.flavor: Its bright red mane gives it the aura of a king. With unmatched strength and courage, it is a reliable leader who never loses to anyone!

species.name: Liquid Cube
species.flavor: It is almost impossible to recognize it in the water.

species.name: Lindwurm
species.flavor: It lives in the sky and soars freely through the air. Compared to other Dragons, its movements are especially swift and agile.

species.name: MagaMocken
species.flavor: A baby monster with a cool green body that crawls on fours. The big ears look like a decoration, but it can hear things clearly. Although whether they are really ears or not is unknown.

species.name: Luvco
species.flavor: An old legend speaks of a young heartbroken woman who jumped into the sea, and her love came back in the form of this monster. The heart on its forehead is the symbol of love.

species.name: Mad Gaboo
species.flavor: A tool to make it obey is buried in its forehead.

species.name: Mage
species.flavor: This monster's might is beyond description.

species.name: Locomotive
species.flavor: It imitated a 'locomotive' which it saw in a foreign country. Its performance is the same as a normal Henger.

species.name: Lycanthroid
species.flavor: Even compared to other Hengars, this one is especially modified to suite air combat. It is said that thousands and thousands of Sky Hengars filled the sky during the ancient war.

species.name: Leziena
species.flavor: It proves that women also participated in ancient battles.

species.name: Lorica
species.flavor: This armor, made out of the shell of Arrow Heads, is light and easy to handle.

species.name: Maestan
species.flavor: Because it's busy listening to all the music in the world, it is always sleep-deprived. It may look unpleasant, but it's really a kind musician at heart.

species.name: Magi
species.flavor: No one knows where it is from. If it proposes a bet using its cards, don't accept; if you lose the bet, you'll lose your life. Watch out!

species.name: Lunasos
species.flavor: Appearing on a moonlit night, it attacks with a blade like the crescent moon. Its eyes are filled with madness.

species.name: LessieOrca
species.flavor: An intelligent and affectionate one among the Lesione species. But it has sharp fangs, and caution is needed when it's in a playful mood.

species.name: Lesione-ish
species.flavor: The youngest of 5 Lesione siblings is often born with unusual coloring. This is called the Lesione-ish, and is usually quite dependent.

species.name: Licorice
species.flavor: With a lovely coat of velvety fur, this one is beautiful!

species.name: Looker
species.flavor: Perhaps the best looking monster of them all.

species.name: Lexus
species.flavor: This monster is best known for his great [[Speed]].

species.name: Lulu (Momo)
species.flavor: Sometimes you will find a wild Lulu while fishing. Fisherpeople love to see Lulu's cute face emerging from the water.

species.name: Ripper (Naga)
species.flavor: Has an array of attacks, but he doesn't trust many people.

species.name: Lovina
species.flavor: This blissed-out monster loves bright colors. It is said that anyone who sees it will become happy, but the happiest of all has to be the monster itself.

species.name: Lily (Pixie)
species.flavor: A mischievous child who likes to play in the water, its shiny skin has a slimy texture and apparently some people have a bad feeling about it.

species.name: Lord Jizo
species.flavor: Lord Jizo seems as though it has finally reached true enlightenment in this world, but it continues to sit still today, seeking even greater heights. I wonder what today's offering will be?

species.name: Manna
species.flavor: It believes that it is the most beautiful monster of all.

species.name: Mum Mew
species.flavor: Another monster who's quite a mixed breed of creatures.

species.name: MaturiDragon
species.flavor: The dashing Edokkodon can't seem to hold onto its money. It often uses rough language although it doesn't know what it means. (Don't ask, because it can't explain.)

species.name: Magmax
species.flavor: It is active, but it becomes lazy when it is kept by humans.

species.name: MahjongKoro
species.flavor: This monster is covered with writing, but not even the most renowned scholars can decipher it. Its name comes from the three words

species.name: Mandrake
species.flavor: When the Mandragora gets mad its flower petals give off an extreme heat. If you're careless and touch it when it's in a bad mood, you'll get an awful burn.

species.name: Malincarin
species.flavor: The Malincarin just loves summer! It carries a swim cap and tube with it the whole year through. But it can't swim. It never even lets go of the tube!

species.name: Magic Bajarl
species.flavor: It is considered to be a descendant from [[Magic]] in [[FIMBA]] area.

species.name: Marshmallow
species.flavor: They are great hunters. The white Jell body blends in perfectly with the snow as they sneak silently up and fire their Jell Cannons.

species.name: Marbel
species.flavor: Its purple body armor is said to actually have been remodeled. It seems to want to fight for justice.

species.name: Marimba
species.flavor: Easily mistaken for a tree, people often try to cut them down. But every time, the three bind tightly together and they are saved.

species.name: Magma Heart
species.flavor: It will immediately attack whoever invades its territory.

species.name: Magnet
species.flavor: A side-to-side mover who can slide out of danger.

species.name: Maverick
species.flavor: The Maverick is said to be the soul from an ancient researcher who sealed himself inside in order to obtain immortality.

species.name: Masala
species.flavor: It used to be a warrior of light, but after it found a demon sword, its mind was lost, and its body color became dark.

species.name: Mariomax
species.flavor: It always cares how it looks. It is a little bit self conceited.

species.name: Mask Worm
species.flavor: Don't let this hard-head get hit in his body or else.

species.name: Matalyn
species.flavor: A nocturnal monster that causes mischief to people throughout the night. Its fickle, and does some farm work at times, earning some affection.

species.name: Massacrer
species.flavor: It is said to have inherited the soul of a cruel nobleman who wore a mask. Rather than a monster, it is closer to an evil spirit.

species.name: Marm
species.flavor: There is a mysterious attractiveness that lingers with its flexible and agile body. The mysteriousness of it is rather charming, making it popular among breeders.

species.name: Mech Hare
species.flavor: It is said to possess dormant electrical power, though there is no visible change in its appearance. In fact, it is more [[Intelligence|intelligent]] than other Hares.

species.name: Maririn
species.flavor: I heard Maririn used to work for a sea god named [[Ogyo]]. They say that Ogyo was a tyrant, and Maririn was always suffering.

species.name: Magic Banana (Monster)
species.flavor: Naga ate a special banana rumored to alter its Lifespan and turned into this incredibly bizarre monster as a result.

species.name: Maharajan
species.flavor: This monster does mystic moves called 'Yogar.' They say that even if it is hurt, using 'Yogar' it can heal quickly. Can this be true?

species.name: Maneplum
species.flavor: It blossoms its flowers beautifully  like a lion's mane. It is very ambitious and will show its aggressive side during combat.

species.name: Marincho
species.flavor: A monster with great fondness for playing with balls so much, that it eventually mad it its house. If you ask nicely to come out and play, it will do so happily.

species.name: Makyu
species.flavor: Makyu mesmerizes its fans with its exciting battles. It is always trying to improve itself, looking for a bigger battlefield.

species.name: Maidchi
species.flavor: A Mocchi that has been trained to help out in household affairs. But, there seems to be a limit to train monsters to help you out in the house. Its cooking is especially awful.

species.name: MariMocchi
species.flavor: A Mocchi covered in green fuzz. It gets really depressed when people say it's grown mold, but don't shouldn't let it bother you!

species.name: Moaigon
species.flavor: Defined by his sad and longing blue eyes, he eyes the past.

species.name: Magna
species.flavor: Immortalized on ancient wall paintings as a great warrior.

species.name: Marble Guy
species.flavor: With his fatal [[Power]], he has killed many. Highly feared.

species.name: Mechael
species.flavor: It was apparently developed to win competitions in a foreign land, but mechanical entrants ended up being banned, so it was reduced to serving as a coin bank.

species.name: Magma Frog
species.flavor: A Kawazumo species that possesses the soul of a Dragon. It is incredibly resilient and highly resistant to heat. It's even said that, for short periods of time, it can swim through molten lava.

species.name: MewBat
species.flavor: Mew types are cute, mysterious creatures, and the Mewbat is the strangest of all. Some say the soul of an [[Abyss]] resides within it, and others just think it's odd by nature.

species.name: Metal Jell
species.flavor: It is very rare. Even if you find it, it will run away quickly.

species.name: Mew-J
species.flavor: A Mew that loves basketball but has no real skills. When it decides to dunk, it always end up going through the hoop rather than the ball.

species.name: Skull Mew
species.flavor: A white skeleton that loves to scare people in dark rooms. Its body pattern was burned there by lightning, but it still likes to take walks on stormy days.

species.name: Melcarba
species.flavor: A mechanical monster who was made before Henger.

species.name: Undine (Pixie)
species.flavor: A Fairy of water, this is where Windine came from. There are rumors it is going out with [[Jell]]. Kind of a careless monster.

species.name: MermaGaru
species.flavor: If you've noticed the MermaGaru's gross yet cute appearance, then you have a discerning eye. But this monster is even odder than it looks. Watch over it, OK?

species.name: Merry Arrow
species.flavor: It is said to have been created to be eaten during a celebratory season, but it evolved a resistance, and as a result, that custom disappeared.

species.name: MewHead
species.flavor: It was named that because of its cat-like friendliness. Be careful, as it will playfully come at you with its claws.

species.name: Mewbyss
species.flavor: This creature may look laid back, but is actually very sensitive. Rumor has it that the Mewbyss loves to sing and dance with its mic when no one else is around.

species.name: Metazorl
species.flavor: It is a Metalner combined with an expressive monster: Suezo.

species.name: Mewco
species.flavor: Falco disguised itself to hide its large body, but its muscles are about to burst from this stuffed animal shell.

species.name: Metanix
species.flavor: A cold-weather type Henger equipped with skis. It must have patrolled the mountainous regions frequently.

species.name: Metal Glory
species.flavor: There is no record showing that this armor has been used in the past.

species.name: Metal Shell
species.flavor: Its body is made out of a strange substance.

species.name: Shishitan
species.flavor: A monster said to live deep in the forest, always traveling in a wild pack. Its name comes from how energetic and lively it is.

species.name: Metal Head
species.flavor: It usually saves energy for upcoming fights by doing nothing. A very clever monster...

species.name: Merlion
species.flavor: Whistle and it will appear for you in a second. It's a very affectionate monster, although whether you can use its agility as well in battles is entirely up to the breeder.

species.name: Metal Glay
species.flavor: This is popular among little kids and tends to be their toy.

species.name: Mermaid (Undine)
species.flavor: This monster appears in fairy tales once in a while.

species.name: Melon Suezo
species.flavor: To no surprise, this melon-looking guy loves fruit.

species.name: Merman
species.flavor: With the gills on its breast, it can breathe underwater. This monster sees itself as a mermaid, but others have trouble with that idea.

species.name: Mewcho
species.flavor: Mewcho loves its 'house' so much that it never comes out. Maybe that's why it hasn't noticed someone took a nice big bite. Ignorance is bliss...

species.name: Mew-ish
species.flavor: This monster was sitting with a lot of stuffed animals but nobody bought it. Next thing it knew, its entire body was covered in tears, hence the color.

species.name: Melon Gaboo
species.flavor: A monster that looks just like a [[Watermelon|certain fruit]]. This appearance is designed to lure opponents into a false sense of security, and if you approach carelessly, you'll be met with a powerful attack.

species.name: Meteorite (Dino)
species.flavor: This monster has a ferocity amplified by the Joker's blood. It wears a creepy mask that makes it impossible to read its expressions, making communication extremely difficult.

species.name: Mercury
species.flavor: Many monsters with Undine blood are known to be kind-hearted, but Mercury is quite tomboyish. Its transparent wings and tail add to its charm.

species.name: Merrow
species.flavor: The 'Singer of the Sea' who lulls people to sleep with its songs. It seems to be popular with men and women, which is perhaps why there are many sad stories of people falling in love with it.

species.name: Mimizo
species.flavor: Its big ears are able to hear distant sounds. Makes a fine watchdog, with such good hearing and the sight of the Suezo species, and stands out among it's kind.

species.name: Mochi Monk
species.flavor: The tropically-grown Peachie releases a sweet fragrance from its body. Despite its large size, it has an equally big heart and a laid-back personality.

species.name: Moch
species.flavor: Although it seems very friendly on the surface, this monster is always thinking of new pranks in the back of its mind. Watch your back!

species.name: Mimiuo
species.flavor: Despite the elegant characteristics of most Ogyos, this breed gives a comical impression which divides the opinions of Ogyo lovers. Very popular with children.

species.name: MewSneak
species.flavor: A thief who disturbs the city every night, stealing instead of working. If she doesn't watch her figure, she soon won't be able to fit into that fur coat.

species.name: Mewseijin
species.flavor: Its body is covered with a special skin, and its large eyes are always shining. There are rumors that it's from another planet, or that is really a machine.

species.name: PsyMew
species.flavor: It's stuffed with beads, so it has no problem in the water. And it's so light it can't help but bound around. Its ambition is to become a bigshot monster someday.

species.name: Mochi Mew
species.flavor: It looks fabulous in its big pink check pattern. It's trimmer than the [[Mocchi]], so it has plenty of confidence in its looks. The shell on its head is extremely hard.

species.name: Miku
species.flavor: When the Miku goes out, it always brings its camera. It takes pictures of flowers and the scenery. But why is there always a bluish-white shadow in every picture?

species.name: MiniOgreKoro
species.flavor: When two of them bang their horns together, they're having a conversation like, 'How you doing?' 'Not bad, you?' But their horns are so small it isn't easy to do.

species.name: Mochi Plant
species.flavor: The Rice-cake Cherry sports pretty blossoms every spring. These blossoms go by quickly, and the best time to view them is a little different each year.

species.name: Mocchisaurus
species.flavor: It's been long-treasured as a messenger of fortune that brings happiness wherever it goes. (This rumor isn't even true, and the poor monster feels pretty pressured...)

species.name: MochiLips
species.flavor: Pease’s dance, born from its love of nature, soothes the heart and brings love and peace!

species.name: Mia
species.flavor: It draws many people's support with its cute charm.

species.name: Miyabiyaken
species.flavor: Known otherwise as the

species.name: Mochiken
species.flavor: Mochiken’s body parts are soft and sticky like rice cakes. But that doesn’t mean you should eat it!

species.name: Milky Way (Gali)
species.flavor: One of the real 'star-gazers' who likes to wish on them.

species.name: Mocky
species.flavor: Mention of its cheap-looking makes this monster mad.

species.name: Mewmew
species.flavor: Mewmew has something resembling a zipper on its back. Therefore, the 'Mewmew is only a costume' theory is even considered plausible in academic circles.

species.name: Mirage Plant
species.flavor: A monster who looks very beautiful and mysterious.

species.name: Mocchini
species.flavor: It always wears black tights in order to protect its legs. It is a fast runner.

species.name: Mocchi-ish
species.flavor: Mocchi-ish has a strong hatred for Mocchi because of its cute demeanor and popularity. But no matter how often it says it hates Mocchi, the feeling's actually closer to envy.

species.name: Mewnda
species.flavor: Mewnda was looking for some oh-so-crunchy magic bamboo once, but forgot what it was doing, and decided to give up.

species.name: Mewkiri
species.flavor: Mewkiri thinks it is a giraffe, so they don't like being called a monster. Nonetheless, it continues to eat fish rather than grass.

species.name: Milim
species.flavor: Curious and tomboyish, it is theorized that she holds the power of a Demon King from another world. Don't let her cute appearance fool you, or you'll be in for a surprise!

species.name: Monzo
species.flavor: Monzo loves listening to gossip, but what it doesn't realize is that its big ears are often the subject of gossip themselves!

species.name: Mumm
species.flavor: Mumm always wakes up early to put on its dress and apron. It is a hard worker, always preparing meals.

species.name: Mustachios
species.flavor: This monster is always clustered with companions.

species.name: Mushtan
species.flavor: The MushTan likes damp, humid places but its personality is unexpectedly bright and cheerful. If you breathe in its spores, you won’t be able to stop laughing.

species.name: Moztan
species.flavor: It somehow got the idea it could be a [[Raiden]] when it grew up, so it trains hard every day. What it doesn't know is that it's been an adult for a long time now.

species.name: Munitan
species.flavor: A kind little monster that always smells good. In spite of the way he looks, he's a boy. People always mistake him for a girl, though, and he doesn't like it.

species.name: Pink Jam
species.flavor: Named after a famous and tasty fruit product.

species.name: Mose
species.flavor: Because of its huge shoulders and horn that can act as a straw to suck [[Honey (Item)|honey]] directly from a beehive, it has come to love sweet things.

species.name: Mr. Fujiyama
species.flavor: Clad in its manly red loincloth, it runs all around town every day.

species.name: Mustard
species.flavor: Acts like a brat though it appears innocent.

species.name: Moo
species.flavor: This dreadful-looking dragon hardly appears even in legends.

species.name: MuiMaya
species.flavor: It can draw power from sunlight, so it loves taking naps in the sun. As a result it sleeps all day, but this can put it in a bad mood, so Breeders should be careful.

species.name: Morlock
species.flavor: It is thought of as a stone monster, but it is said that the jewel held in the eyes are the core of what controls its life formulating stony body.

species.name: Mono-Eyed
species.flavor: This one-eyed wonder is very friendly. Kids love him.

species.name: Monol-ish
species.flavor: A genius scientist was said to have created this monster as a Monol imitation, but had no idea what to use it for when finished. But he was pretty proud of getting the levitation right.

species.name: Munlee
species.flavor: This sweet monster performs under the solitude of the desert moon. Dancers often use it in their designs.

species.name: Momotero
species.flavor: A subspecies of Antero distinguished by markings that resemble the 'Sakura Blizzard' technique used by the [[Mocchi]] species. Unlike the ordinary Anteros, it is less wary of people and is said to become attached to humans more easily.

species.name: Mustardy
species.flavor: It is playful, and tends to carry its jokes too far.

species.name: Nightfang
species.flavor: One touch of its sleek, dark body and you'll get a glimpse into its cold and unforgiving heart. But in battle, its graceful moves will impress you.

species.name: Nedel
species.flavor: This ecological Golem likes places with lots of wind from which it can generate energy. Kids love it because it looks like a toy.

species.name: Ormeka
species.flavor: This ancient and mysterious Golem was just recently discovered. Its body was covered with moss, so it must have been there awhile.

species.name: Night Sickle
species.flavor: A slightly odd monster that likes suspenseful horror movies. Quite intelligent, it sees through the traps laid by its opponents with a cool, clear head.

species.name: Niezheg
species.flavor: Its dazzling purple skin is said to be an advertisement of its own aggressiveness.

species.name: Naskaova
species.flavor: The strange and ancient Henger robot evolved into this monster, with a body particularly suited for battle. Present-day science can't explain its mysteries.

species.name: Nagisa
species.flavor: Warm-blooded like humans, she has a soft jelly body.

species.name: Night-Flyer
species.flavor: Her radar-like antennas help her to dodge opponents.

species.name: Mustard Arrow
species.flavor: Dropping tears does not always mean that it is sad.

species.name: Ninja
species.flavor: Due to its tendency to remain hidden in the darkness, it is rarely found. It use to be raised as a spy in the past.

species.name: Nasupen
species.flavor: Though it looks like it can fly, it in fact spends its time swimming. It demonstrates characteristics that fit surprisingly well in any environment.

species.name: Naguaco
species.flavor: Naguaco has a solid balance of power and magic, and is always training for the sake of keeping others safe.

species.name: Noble Saurian
species.flavor: It is considered to be a status symbol among noble people.

species.name: Nis
species.flavor: It lives in a cold region. Though looks aggressive at first glance, it's not a bad monster. In fact, if you're nice to it, it'll help you out with work.

species.name: NorMaya
species.flavor: The most ancient type out of the Maya species. Its temperament is somewhat rough, and shows little affection for attachment. But once it gets used to you, it quickly forgets its wild instincts.

species.name: Ninja Kato
species.flavor: It originated from a Kato with master ninja skills.

species.name: Naga Saurian
species.flavor: Since it is a descendant from Naga, it is rather violent.

species.name: New Leaf
species.flavor: This guy has a striking resemblance to a local tree.

species.name: Naga-ish
species.flavor: Naga-ish no longer has use for its eyes due to living in the dark depths of a cave for so long. Its other senses were sharpened as a result, which means its prey never gets away.

species.name: Neon
species.flavor: This monster is absolutely bursting with [[geonyte|energy]].

species.name: Noble Witch
species.flavor: Amongst the [[Witch]]es, the most outstanding are called the Noble Witches. It seems that its enemies are overwhelmed by its noble aura.

species.name: Narikirog
species.flavor: A Kawazumo species recognized by its trademark silk hat and cane. Although it considers itself a fellow gentleman, it apparently harbors a secret rivalry with the [[Gentle Mocchi]].

species.name: Night Flight
species.flavor: A nocturnal Piroro that moves under the cover of darkness. Because of its striking appearance, it is often referred to as a mysterious creature. It is known by the nickname 'Luminous Moth' and is a beautiful clown-like monster.

species.name: Nekobō
species.flavor: Nekobō loves to play and get into mischief. If you don't keep it strictly disciplined, it may do things you never expected. It's very popular with grandpas and grandmas.

species.name: Nycta
species.flavor: The Nycta's large, wide beak snaps up every last bit of food in sight. If you don't watch out, it just might snap you up, too!

species.name: Nutcho
species.flavor: A big walnut that ripens once 100 year on the big tree that has lived for 1000 years. Inside it lies a secret jewel. There was such a legend past, but it was actually just Nutcho.

species.name: Nyankoro
species.flavor: Since it is a descendent from [[Kato]], it looks like an old cat.

species.name: Oh
species.flavor: Even among Golems, which pride themselves on their strength, this flamboyant egotist is noticeably strong. Is it for real?

species.name: Tanmarin
species.flavor: I've no idea what it is thinking, but it does have cute eyes. Careful, if you let your guard down near it, you're liable to get poked!

species.name: Plauna
species.flavor: This calm character loves to stand in the green grass and breathe deeply. It might not do well in a place too cold or too hot.

species.name: Serenity
species.flavor: A very kind and gentle being who isn't good at fighting.

species.name: Omega
species.flavor: From an ancient race, he can change like a shapeshifter.

species.name: Oldovis
species.flavor: One of the monsters with the oldest history, but its [[Power]] still has not declined.

species.name: Nut Arrow
species.flavor: It is said that every time it cracks walnuts, its claws get stronger. A hard working monster.

species.name: Octoban
species.flavor: When the soft-spoken Octoban enters into a dull tournament it's sure get more exciting!

species.name: Nussie
species.flavor: It is the type of monster that won't risk anything.

species.name: Octgon
species.flavor: A cruel monster that attacks ships crossing the sea. It is feared by sailors.

species.name: Octon
species.flavor: The Ducken’s movements combined with Octopee's softness, it has evolved into an even stranger monster called Octon.

species.name: Ombren
species.flavor: The Gali cast away its evil heart through intense training, but when only its dark aspects take physical form, it becomes the Garinokage.

species.name: Oct Knight
species.flavor: The armor of a knight who once defeated a sea monster has been cursed by the creature and now moves on its own.

species.name: Odium
species.flavor: It is said that its spell causes its enemy to be unable to move.

species.name: Purple Suezo
species.flavor: Although he may fail your expectations, he's strong.

species.name: Octomee
species.flavor: An ancient race attempted to give eternal life to this monster. Judging by all those bandages, the experiment must have failed...

species.name: Obelisk
species.flavor: This monster looks a little ordinary. He has high [[Defense|Def]]..

species.name: Ogyo-ish
species.flavor: Ogyo-ish lives deeper beneath the sea than any other Ogyo monster. It continues to save up its energy far beneath the sea where no sunshine has ever reached.

species.name: Offshore
species.flavor: This one likes to sit underwater, moving along with the current. Unfortunately, sometimes fish lay eggs in its hair.

species.name: Ogre
species.flavor: It doesn't need a reason to fight - it's a fighter through and through. However, battles that require strategy and careful thinking may be a little difficult for it, perhaps?

species.name: Odin
species.flavor: It is revered as the 'God of the Spear,' and its ability to wield its weapon as if it were an extension of its own body is the admired by all other Centaurs.

species.name: Oceanus
species.flavor: Also known as the 'Angel of the Seashore' because of its transparent appearance, there are many who say her tears have saved them from trouble, so it apparently has a large fan club.

species.name: Nyarudā
species.flavor: Exceptionally good at singing and dancing, she's everyone's cheerful, energetic idol. Nyaruda actually loves sleeping, and when nobody can see her, she's always fast asleep - but she's scary when she first wakes up.

species.name: OPMocchi
species.flavor: Why is OPMocchi the most stylish Mocchi on his block? Easy! He gets his lifestyle tips from the greatest magazine around: Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine!

species.name: Paper Dragon
species.flavor: 1000 pieces of Origami made by a ill boy, combined into one and turned into a dragon. According to the legend, the boy's illness has since cured.

species.name: Panthy
species.flavor: Wearing today's most stylin' outfit, Panthy is known among young Breeders for its charisma.

species.name: Pansy
species.flavor: A fairy with a sad past in which it lost everything. It stopped smiling, and its eyes became red from crying for so long.

species.name: Owlbeard
species.flavor: The Owlbeard, with eyes full of sorrow and a heart that shuns fighting. Its cry is even sometimes called the 'Symbol of Peace.'

species.name: PandiBaku
species.flavor: A legendary monster that lives deep in the mountains. Despite its big body, it's pretty gentle. It likes to eat a plant called 'sasa.'

species.name: Peach Tree Bug
species.flavor: It is cute, but you should know that it is a bit too noisy.

species.name: Peachrin
species.flavor: The PeachRin smells so good you just want to grab it. It's a really good singer, too. Lavishing smiles on everyone is its greatest pleasure.

species.name: PanQuiche
species.flavor: Its thick eyebrows prove it has a strong sense of justice. It hates wrong-doing. Come on and give it your best shot! It'll greet you with its spiky drill.

species.name: Owlden
species.flavor: This monster is rumored to be a transformed magic-school teacher from a magic country. If anybody finds out, it'll have to go back, so don't ask it about it.

species.name: Peacocken
species.flavor: Priding itself on its beautiful feathers and its aesthetic sense, it's a monster fashion leader. Too many people hunted it for its feathers and few remain.

species.name: Osaka Knight
species.flavor: Since the day it awoke to the ways of chivalry, it's devoted itself to being the best knight ever. Its only worry is that it sinks in water because of its armor.

species.name: Pa Bil Sag
species.flavor: Its name means 'The [[Night Scorpion|Scorpion]]’s Tail.' As its name suggests, it defeats opponents with its powerful tail. Its existence is almost god-like.

species.name: Purple Jell
species.flavor: He has a very short memory. Can't remember a thing.

species.name: Pantheon
species.flavor: A mysterious monster believed to have perished in ancient times. It has recently been confirmed to exist again, but what happened during its period of absence is unknown to anyone.

species.name: Orchestron
species.flavor: A possessed trumpet used by a famous trumpeter is said to have turned into a monster. By combining with various musical instruments, it is able to perform as an orchestra.

species.name: Peachdillo
species.flavor: Its yellow beak is a sign of how much it can talk. Unlike most taciturn Madillos, it's a real chatterbox. The shell on its back is actually soft and sticky, they say.

species.name: Oscerot
species.flavor: This monster keeps a collection of oil pot in his house.

species.name: Paradocken
species.flavor: Its poisonous-looking colors made people think it was a toy-like assassination weapon, but it was simply just made in poor taste.

species.name: Suezo Mask
species.flavor: Once his mask is on, he's cursed for life. Careful!

species.name: Ornamenger
species.flavor: A Henger who often only appears at the beginning of the year, making it a very auspicious monster. Its body is decorated in various places with designs that are said to bring good fortune.

species.name: Pain
species.flavor: A Hare that fell into [[Joker]]'s trap and was consumed by the power of [[Element|darkness]]! The cheerful Hare it once was is gone, and now it exists only to bring destruction.

species.name: Pebbly
species.flavor: This Golem doll is made of stone and is too heavy for children.

species.name: Palasaulo
species.flavor: What looks like a long horn is actually a nose, which allows it to breathe underwater. It is the champion of the swimming contest each year.

species.name: Pashminer
species.flavor: Pashminer is so proud of its gorgeous muffler. It fancies itself to be quite stylish, but no one else really thinks so.

species.name: Parasaur
species.flavor: Because it swims at high speed through the water and catches all the fish, fishermen fear it. It's nicknamed 'Sea Storm.'

species.name: Orion
species.flavor: Look into his eye and you can see the whole universe.

species.name: Ootan
species.flavor: This monster was raised in the forest as a wolf. It howls at the full moon with its big mouth. Isn't that a little annoying?

species.name: Pancho-ish
species.flavor: Pancho was fused together with a giant monster pumpkin, but that pumpkin rotted and turned blue, which really isn't all that bad.

species.name: Osiris
species.flavor: Among the types of Gali, this one gives off a particularly quiet and serene aura. In desert regions, it is highly respected by people and considered a god who presides over death and rebirth.

species.name: Pipo Ape
species.flavor: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. Will a monster like this really take its training seriously...?

species.name: Pink Eye
species.flavor: Used to be able to fly with his wings, but he can't anymore.

species.name: Pink Hopper
species.flavor: It is a combined monster from two other popular monsters, but it is not popular.

species.name: Pirate Ape
species.flavor: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. It has confidence in its ability to run away. It dresses like a pirate, but some say it's just for show.

species.name: Pink Princess
species.flavor: After a long sleep on the ocean bottom, the Pink Princess is now enraptured by everything she sees.

species.name: Rhinocerous
species.flavor: A monster clad in armor extravagantly adorned with jewels. It is said to have once been a flamboyant nobleman’s treasured possession.

species.name: Pirahnikoro
species.flavor: The Pirahnikoro looks like the legendary Tsuchinoko creature. It was once really popular, but not so much anymore. If you really look at it, it's kind of cute...

species.name: Pixie-ish
species.flavor: Pixie-ish pretends to be a Pixie, does bad things, and blames them all on Pixie. It's really just for attention.

species.name: Pedrolino
species.flavor: It's said that there resides a soul of a performer inside this flexible body. But whether it can actually do this or not depends on whether it feels like it or not.

species.name: Phantom
species.flavor: It never shows itself on the forefront, always protecting the peace from behind the scenes. The lonely hero, its true form is still a mystery.

species.name: Pict
species.flavor: With its red mane and large feet, it is very cute. Among the Garu, it is especially hardworking, and can even build a large house in just one night!

species.name: Tropical Ape
species.flavor: He will emit a potent and intoxicating scent to foes.

species.name: Pillard
species.flavor: Pillard is a legendary monster admired by carpenters the world over for its leadership skills. Every day there are many people requesting to be its apprentice.

species.name: Pitan
species.flavor: There are no surprises here, a scheming character that keeps its intentions in the dark. Its sharp-edged wings are weapons to be wary of.

species.name: Piekan
species.flavor: It is believed to be a toy for girls from an ancient civilization, but whether it was actually popular is uncertain.

species.name: Piroco
species.flavor: Monster battles aren't the only things that make people happy. Falco's peace-loving heart changed into an interesting monster shape and appeared as this.

species.name: Pierry
species.flavor: This monster is used to gather lumps of ice in high mountains.

species.name: Pithecan
species.flavor: There is a scholar who says that humans are descended from this monster.

species.name: Pitbocor
species.flavor: A sinister monster that revives the dead and freely controls them. It is said that it uses the monsters it has revived to attack people.

species.name: Pink Kato
species.flavor: This monster likes its own cherry blossom-colored body.

species.name: Pink Zilla
species.flavor: It has a beautiful white body, and strong confidence.

species.name: Petit Knight
species.flavor: It is the most popular doll and is often out of stock.

species.name: PieRipper
species.flavor: A thug of the sea, a pirate monster that worked under [[Captain Zakk]]. It's very good at combat in unstable places. If it successfully becomes attached to you, it will soon listen to your orders.

species.name: Piroro-ish
species.flavor: Piroro often performs comedy acts to entertain guests, putting on various silly outfits to make them laugh. What do you think of today's costume?

species.name: Phoenix-ish
species.flavor: This Phoenix lost its life-giving flames, resulting in this oddly colored skin. Even without flames, it is still quite wise.

species.name: Pepe (Momo)
species.flavor: Pepe is popular with children because of its cute walk, but Pepe actually does not like kids much because they always mess up its neat hair.

species.name: Persim
species.flavor: As its name suggests, Persim absolutely loves dried [[persimmon]]s. When asked whether it would choose dried persimmons or [[Walnut|walnuts]], it spent an entire day agonizing over the decision.

species.name: Peligoon
species.flavor: This cool Pelican is proud of how its beak can hold anything. Will it come to hold your heart, too?

species.name: Phowou
species.flavor: This monster will one day be legendary. It has a strong sense of fairness, and in that red body a heart burns with the flame of justice.

species.name: Petraden
species.flavor: If you want to know this monster's history, just ask. It isn't called a living fossil just for show it really has lived through an eternity.

species.name: Pixel
species.flavor: Perhaps best known as one of the smartest monsters.

species.name: Player
species.flavor: He is a regular sports fanatic who especially likes baseball.

species.name: Pooch
species.flavor: Pooch looks like your average dog at first glance, but is said to be very smart, and can even talk. It's actually a very sensitive dog that loves to travel on its own.

species.name: Puddingel (Suzurin Sub)
species.flavor: This Jell monster loves the sound of the [[Suzurin]]'s bell. It wishes it could be a bell and make such a pretty sound, too! (That's why it eats so much metal.).

species.name: Poseidon
species.flavor: Like the mythical Greek god, he rules the water.

species.name: Platinum
species.flavor: A monster who can sing and dance well. Great rhythm.

species.name: Psirow
species.flavor: This strong, patterned monster carries the pride of all past generations on his shoulders. That's why the Psirow feels he just has to win!

species.name: PodDog
species.flavor: A battle machine created ages ago. To be compatible with humans, it was loaded with a prototype emotions AI, but apparently it doesn't work very well.

species.name: Planekken
species.flavor: This mystery monster is said to have been bathed in starlight for 1,000 years. Its secrets have yet to be revealed.

species.name: Puddingel (??? Sub)
species.flavor: A very tasty-looking monster. It's true what they say, that the [[Tochika]]ns invented pudding after first seeing a Puddingel.

species.name: PrincessKoro
species.flavor: The PrincessKoro and Koroball are rivals. So far the record stands at 2-2. The PrincessKoro won the

species.name: ProtoAnt
species.flavor: A rare, Antlan-type robot weapon created by long-ago scientists. Thanks to the huge radar on its forehead, it has amazing control over its attacks.

species.name: Silhouette
species.flavor: Covered with a unique, highly-protective shield.

species.name: Poison
species.flavor: They say it is hysterical. But the truth is unknown.

species.name: Priarocks
species.flavor: This monster inhabits the desert and is nocturnal.

species.name: Puck
species.flavor: It is a little closer to the gods than other Garu breeds, but it remains just as mischievous as ever. If it keeps playing pranks, it’s going to get scolded!

species.name: Piyoken
