species.flavor: Though Piyoken looks like a chick, its strength is that of an adult, or even beyond. However, it still waddles around like a baby, no matter how much time passes.

species.name: Psiken
species.flavor: Psiken is said to have been given the ability to operate underwater as well, but it seems to dislike water.

species.name: Pong-Pong
species.flavor: This one is a meat lover and a glutton.

species.name: Proto
species.flavor: An example of how monsters are not merely 'robots.'

species.name: Proto Zero
species.flavor: This prototype was the original design for the Hengar. Its destructive power and intelligence are quite amazing for a Hengar type, but it wasn't mass produced due to violent streaks.

species.name: Prius
species.flavor: A state-of-the-art Henger made using all of the ancient technology. It is kind to children and to the environment; A dream Henger.

species.name: Plague Joker
species.flavor: Its scythe looks like a big claw and actually has a very sharp point. If you are intrigued by its unbalanced look, you will get in trouble.

species.name: Prince Hare
species.flavor: He's a monster who is most popular among noble people.

species.name: Pole Mock
species.flavor: It stands in dark places and eats bugs that were lured.

species.name: Planet
species.flavor: This is a very rare type of monster. He's celestial.

species.name: Piyopi
species.flavor: This Octopee was born from a hard-shelled egg. It continues to switch shells as it grows, much like a hermit crab.

species.name: Prepee
species.flavor: Its dignified bearing and refined features make it look well-bred. When it strolls through town with its magnificent ears flowing in the breeze, everyone turns to look!

species.name: Plant-ish
species.flavor: Plant-ish was born in the far north, where ice, snow, and blizzards are plentiful. People say this monster reminds them of [[diamond]] dust.

species.name: Pressure
species.flavor: It cannot float on the water like Zilla. It is too heavy.

species.name: Priest
species.flavor: During the [[The Final War|ancient war]], it was this Priest who stood against the rampaging [[Gobi]]s. It placed itself in harm’s way, becoming a shield to protect the people.

species.name: PumpkiMochi
species.flavor: Some people say PumpkiMochi is just a regular Mocchi wearing a costume. There's definitely something suspicious about how hard it denies it... (Just kidding.)

species.name: Punisher
species.flavor: It is said that it was actually raised by another monster.

species.name: Rabicho
species.flavor: Its soft and springy afro smells like sweet chocolate. Some people train it as a guard dog because of its ability to quickly sense odd situations and hear things thanks to its Hare ancestry.

species.name: PumpkiDuck
species.flavor: All Duckens love pumpkins. They say this monster looks like this because it ate so many of them. Lately it's been worried about getting eaten by other Duckens...

species.name: PuppyKoro
species.flavor: When you feed the PuppyKoro, you'd better bring them extra food, because all three of them are real gluttons. Don't let them get hungry!

species.name: PumpkiPlant
species.flavor: It has a scary face, but it only looks scary. Actually, it's just a big coward. If you surprise it, it cries and runs away, so you've got to sneak up on it.

species.name: Rabbirin
species.flavor: A very popular monster, with its soft hat and squishy body. It takes to people easily so [[Breeder|breeders]] love it. Now all it has to do is put up some effort in the arena.

species.name: QueenRoller
species.flavor: The 'Queen of the Highway,' many a breeder has been captivated by its elegance and smooth ride. It even has quite a few fan clubs!

species.name: Putaranoden
species.flavor: It used to have big wings but its constant training made them shrink. Repeated punching made its hands big, too. But it still has sharp talons at its elbows...

species.name: RageRock
species.flavor: It holds amazing [[Power|strength]] within its shockingly small body. Lifting anything is a piece of cake.

species.name: Quintie
species.flavor: The feelings Quintie has for its horns are intense; if the angles don't look just right, it doesn’t have the will to do anything all day.

species.name: Radial
species.flavor: A difficult monster to breed. Has high [[Speed]].

species.name: Quellepre
species.flavor: It is said to be a prehistoric monster that survived deep in the [[Tapota Jungle]]. Whether it is true or not remains a mystery to this day.

species.name: Quailken
species.flavor: It was given this name because it looks just like an egg, but it is rumored to be a messenger from the gods. However, there is absolutely no sign of that.

species.name: Purple Mask
species.flavor: He has a mouth with tusks on his mask that never opens.

species.name: Purple Worm
species.flavor: All the kids seem to be afraid of this guy.

species.name: Pururu
species.flavor: A flexible body with wavy moves. As well as a fondness to please spectators with its performances. Its popularity among breeders is understandable. A monster to be raised at least once.

species.name: Radial Niton
species.flavor: It is said that there was a play titled '<nowiki/>''Cars''' in the ancient era.

species.name: RabbiRoller
species.flavor: One day, a snow rabbit found a roller, sat on it, and found it could not let go. This is how the Rabbiroller was born.

species.name: Raggae Plant
species.flavor: This monster loves a certain kind of music very much.

species.name: Pulcinella
species.flavor: It will do anything for the sake of performance, and so decided to possess the tools used in the performance. But is it righteous to use the tools as its weapons and shields during combat?

species.name: Ra
species.flavor: Because the blood of opposing elemental monsters was mixed together, it has come to possess a dual nature of kindness and cruelty. A type of god, believed to travel the [[Land of Chaos|world of the dead]].

species.name: Red Shorts Ape
species.flavor: An odd monkey that wandered here from a distant land. It has a frightening glare, but we hope it's really a good monster deep down...

species.name: Red Hot Baku
species.flavor: This monster is indeed a

species.name: Ray (Zan)
species.flavor: The Ray lives in a land of ice. It has a gentle spirit, but once the battle begins, it gets an expression on its face that sends chills down its opponent's spine.

species.name: Raiducken
species.flavor: Extremely popular with kids, the Raiducken is a slightly surreal superstar. Not only does it have a brightly-colored body, but it's also a true martial artist!

species.name: Ramuna
species.flavor: With a single jump, the Ramuna sets off a whirlwind that tears everything around it to pieces. Be careful when you go near it!

species.name: Rhinorhine
species.flavor: Despite the way it looks, this monster is the fastest Antlan, but it's not very good at using its brakes and crashes into things to stop. That's why it's banged up.

species.name: Renocraft
species.flavor: This monster is a prototype made by engineers prior to Henger.

species.name: Reaper
species.flavor: It was created by Joker, but it even hates him.

species.name: RhinoTank
species.flavor: Living on the prairie, it rolls along and can cover over 600 miles a day. Every summer, it has a speed race with the Rhinoroller. Which will win this year?

species.name: Rainbow (Doodle)
species.flavor: This Doodle has returned in full color! It was already mysterious enough, but now it's become even more incomprehensible...

species.name: Razwel
species.flavor: It was created to protect the [[Paradise of Monsters|Garden of Angels]]. Its fragrance is said to bring about death...

species.name: Rear-Eyed
species.flavor: It has the third eye in the back of its head.

species.name: Reflector
species.flavor: Its technique reflects back any attack; the secret is to evade and then counter! Even if you know it’s coming, it cannot be stopped.

species.name: Red Worm
species.flavor: Although his wings don't let him fly, he can jump.

species.name: Redcap
species.flavor: A monster that lives in abandoned or crumbling houses and plays pranks on people. It is said to always appear and roam around wherever battles or conflicts occur.

species.name: Rhigitan
species.flavor: Though small, it carries itself with confidence and dignity, and is said to have the potential to become something great in the future. It’s hoped that it won’t turn into a [[:Category:Baddies|baddie]].

species.name: Requiem
species.flavor: A messenger from hell, dressed in a black cloak. But once, he was a radiant, shining angel. His white wings are proof of that.

species.name: Retsu
species.flavor: Impressed by the lifestyle of a crayfish, it tries every day to live like one. This is why it is so good at fighting underwater.

species.name: Remus
species.flavor: This monster was recently discovered in the jungle. Its fur acts as camouflage, which is why no one could find it before.

species.name: Rayrin
species.flavor: A fairy from the land of [[Chuka]]. Despite the pale face, it's very healthy. It loves to take naps, but don't spoil it too much.

species.name: Raipenpenn
species.flavor: It has a rather indistinct face, but this monster can't. be tricked. Called

species.name: Rapper
species.flavor: Its best quality is that it always looks on the bright side. No matter how tough the battle, it says, 'I can do it!' and somehow manages to overcome it. What an amazing little guy!

species.name: Rhinogigas
species.flavor: It hides itself deep within the jungle. Despite its large size, it is surprisingly skilled at hiding, making it quite difficult to find!

species.name: RedShell
species.flavor: It is difficult to move its joints because of its shell.

species.name: Rimuru
species.flavor: Because it has a round, wobbly body, it is affectionately known as 'Slime' in the [[IMa]] Region. Its original good, such as [[manju]] (sweet buns) are extremely popular.

species.name: RygaRoller
species.flavor: Searching for a certain princess in a faraway land, it somehow found itself in this world. Sometimes it stands looking out to sea, remembering that princess...

species.name: Rocky Fur
species.flavor: A close friend of [[Scaler]] that has good [[defense]] and poor [[speed]].

species.name: Rubberabby
species.flavor: Also sometimes called

species.name: Rollbeat
species.flavor: A monster that loves being in the sea, it moves quickly through the water. Its pink body color washes off the minute it touches water. It looks happiest when eating.

species.name: Tecno Dragon
species.flavor: A robot monster and one of the hardest to obtain.

species.name: RoseoCobra
species.flavor: The Roseo Cobra usually has soft, velvety skin, but the dry area it lives in makes it rough. That's why this monster spends the whole day just caring for its skin.

species.name: Rinka (Zan)
species.flavor: The Rinka's slender body is made with a special kind of glass. The wind makes a noise as it passes over this body so this monster is also often called 'Rinkabell.'

species.name: RocknRoller
species.flavor: Despite its hefty-looking appearance, it's got a lightning-fast spin. With its rhythm and impressive running speed, they call it the 'Speed Race King.'

species.name: Rose River
species.flavor: They appear in groups along the rivers in the spring, and it is said that their name was given because of the beauty of the scenery they create.

species.name: Rugaru
species.flavor: Also known as the cursed Garu. Those who wear its fur lose their sanity and go on a rampage!

species.name: Rock Ape
species.flavor: Won't move for hours at a time, just like a stone statue.

species.name: Ruby Knight
species.flavor: It is said that it was the armor for the ancient royal guard.

species.name: Ruin Sector
species.flavor: The armor of Ruin Sector, also known as 'Neck Slicer,' was possessed by the soul of a monster. We still don't know what happened to Ruin.

species.name: Roborabi
species.flavor: A monster that looks like a combat type robot, although it is actually a robot type pet. It is understood why it behaves rather cute despite its looks.

species.name: Rock Worm
species.flavor: This one dwells between the rocks. He can't see well.

species.name: Rock Saurian
species.flavor: It can move quicker than its looks, but it is not very smart.

species.name: Rock Hound
species.flavor: One his heavy body lies on you, you'll be pinned.

species.name: Ruby (Tiger)
species.flavor: The red body signifies the blood of [[Nagazi]], the strongest monster of all. Maybe there is a [[Breeder]] who can revive this monster.

species.name: Rocky
species.flavor: Named because he disguises himself to look like a rock.

species.name: Roro
species.flavor: The thing Roro carries that looks like a walnut is actually the seed of a giant [[plum]]! Did Roro eat the whole plum by itself?

species.name: Romper Wall
species.flavor: This monster has high [[Intelligence|Int]]. and is a kind soul to breed.

species.name: Rock Plant
species.flavor: You need a good cleanser for scrubbing this guy down.

species.name: Rudolphus
species.flavor: A Dino species from colder regions that has undergone a unique evolution to give it thick, fluffy fur. It eats food found in the snow, and has acquired large antlers.

species.name: Scalie
species.flavor: Some ornaments are made out of its green scales.

species.name: Salamander (Zuum)
species.flavor: Its IQ is lower than Dragon's. It is very fast and violent.

species.name: Santa
species.flavor: His small body allows him to fit down your chimney.

species.name: Ryulon
species.flavor: The two beautiful horns tell us this is the King of Tigers. Unlike the others, they live in packs and take care of their families.

species.name: Saga
species.flavor: It appears out of the darkness and vanishes again without a sound. Many die before they even realize its presence. The Saga, a silent assassin.

species.name: Ryoku
species.flavor: This nice monster traded in some of its battle power for its soft, velvety skin. The biggest drawback is that now it sometimes can't tear itself away from the mirror.

species.name: Scarabio
species.flavor: The Scarapio's favorite food is the sweet nectar of flowers. Because it readily follows anybody that'll give it nectar, it often goes missing. Breeders beware!

species.name: Samurairin
species.flavor: Some people think it left its hometown just so it could come back in triumph. It really should stop saying, 'Don't wanna!' to everything...

species.name: Saint Arrow
species.flavor: Its pure white body is proof of divine lineage. As a sacred monster, it is commonly worshipped in desert regions.

species.name: Sabani
species.flavor: A rare monster that inhabits a [[Age|small island]] in the south. Even if you find it, it wanders off and disappears somewhere.

species.name: Scales
species.flavor: Despite his appearance, he's vulnerable to attacks.

species.name: Scaled Jell
species.flavor: Its gelled sections are harder than its scaled sections.

species.name: Sam
species.flavor: Resembling the American flag, this patriotic guy is tough.

species.name: Samson
species.flavor: Samson, a [[power]]-loving fighter, enters battle today with its proud super strength. If only it were just a little bit smarter...

species.name: Scaled Mask
species.flavor: Its mask is covered with scales like [[Dino]] and [[Zuum]].

species.name: Scaled Hare
species.flavor: Its ability to jump is better than that of other Hares.

species.name: Sand Lessie
species.flavor: This monster was thought of as royal and noble since it used to carry the King on its back. You can see this in the insignia on its forehead.

species.name: Scaled Worm
species.flavor: It hides its legs and uses them only for quick movement.

species.name: Satan Clause
species.flavor: A festival doll became possessed and then became this monster.

species.name: Sand Saurian
species.flavor: Most monsters dislike the desert, but this one does not.

species.name: Scar-Claw
species.flavor: When it hides among the grass, its appearance becomes a perfect camouflage, making it nearly impossible to notice. Patiently lying in wait for prey, it bursts out with breathtaking speed to capture its target.

species.name: Salome
species.flavor: The red eyes that dance in the dark forests are scary indeed. It slowly creeps up on its enemies, and its attacking capabilities are known for their deadliness.

species.name: Sandy
species.flavor: An abrasive skin makes him unsuitable for petting.

species.name: Scaler
species.flavor: A close friend of [[Stoner]] that has good [[Speed]] and poor [[Defense]].

species.name: Ryozan
species.flavor: Sometimes, this monster starts hibernating before the winter comes, which is why many Breeders have given up on this monster.

species.name: Scaled Plant
species.flavor: Its green body is luminous at night, so many people have it.

species.name: Saboran
species.flavor: A famous story describes how a Plant fell in love with a desert Chickchick and had a [[CobraLord|Lord]] change it into a Cactaran. If it sees a Chickchick, the flowers turn red.

species.name: Sand Golem
species.flavor: It will not forgive anyone who breaks its quiet living.

species.name: Santy
species.flavor: This doll might be based on either the designer or the [[IMa]] president.

species.name: Sakura Frog
species.flavor: Despite its appearance, it's surprisingly agile, dancing like a shower of cherry blossoms to defeat its foes. In foreign competitions, it is known as 'The Marketplace of [[:Category:Techniques|Techniques]]' because of its vast repertoire of moves.

species.name: Scribble
species.flavor: The markings all over hia body were in fact a punishment.

species.name: Sharly
species.flavor: The Sharlie, the gentlest of all Lesiones. It loves to take afternoon naps more than anything else. (The thing it loves second best is eating.)

species.name: Shellincho
species.flavor: It lives in the sea where the currents are calm. It is said that this monster was born from the teardrops of a [[mermaid]]. How poetic!

species.name: Shidao
species.flavor: The Shidao can read the wind and predict the weather and earthquakes, but it never shares its knowledge. Try touching its nose. If it's wet, it'll rain tomorrow!

species.name: Selketo
species.flavor: It has thousands of thorns, and stings whoever touches it.

species.name: Scorpion
species.flavor: A monster that possesses the soul of a [[Scorpion King|once-great king]]. Overflowing with confidence no matter what opponent it faces, it stands ready, challenging them: 'Come at me!'

species.name: Shadow Mage
species.flavor: The Shadow Mage is a model of righteous thought, and highly-skilled at the magic arts, but its severe techniques strike fear in the hearts of others.

species.name: Shades
species.flavor: He's thought to be born of human ancestry.

species.name: Scissors
species.flavor: The scissor-shaped horns on its head cut anything. If it abuses the horns, they fall off, but that is okay because they'll grow back quickly.

species.name: Scorpi
species.flavor: This savage monster has poison at the tip of its horn. However, about 10 of them die each year due to their own poison, which is kind of silly...

species.name: Shel
species.flavor: His shell keeps people off his back. His belly is vulnerable.

species.name: Searcher
species.flavor: A tracking machine made to discover any intruders. Once it sets it’s sights on something, there’s no point in running.

species.name: Selvan
species.flavor: It is said that the soul of a legendary swordsman resides within it, and its swordsmanship is truly exceptional!

species.name: Sea Bishop
species.flavor: A priest who vanished into the sea during a storm is said to have become a Sea Bishop, but no longer retains a human heart.

species.name: Shearsman
species.flavor: It is said to lurk within a cursed castle and slash everything to pieces. Where the lord of that castle disappeared to remains a mystery to this day.

species.name: Seapea
species.flavor: Very gentle and kind, it's an ideal playmate for children. When it is in a good mood, it will show you some tricks.

species.name: Setsuna
species.flavor: Its golden body is a symbol of royalty. With a single swift move, it can deliver a fatal blow to its enemies.

species.name: Shell Saurian
species.flavor: Various Knights rode on its back and fight in the ancient era.

species.name: Seniorin
species.flavor: If you are ever lost in the desert, try calling for Seniorin! Though it can't help you, it will make you forget about everything with its funky dance.

species.name: Seaguile
species.flavor: Born in a region surrounded by sea, it has evolved to survive in both air and water. Its evolutionary effort is something of an amazement to scientists.

species.name: Shanx (Ducken Sub)
species.flavor: It is said to have mastered a traditional dance from an ancient civilization. Where it learned the dance, however, remains a mystery.

species.name: Shalltear
species.flavor: Characterized by her long silver hair and dark dress, she is a beautiful member of the Illumine species. She excels at both hand-to-hand combat and magic, and is deadly with a spear. Contrary to her lovely appearance, she has a cruel personality.

species.name: Shyanne
species.flavor: The strongest of its tribe, Shyanne travels the world in search of its lost partner. The word 'strongest' really applies to entertainment but it can hold its own in battle.

species.name: Skipper
species.flavor: It will move seductively when someone touches its horn.

species.name: SkelePlant
species.flavor: The Corpse Weed grows by sucking negative emotions out of people. Its pollen is a powerful poison. Not even a [[Dragon]] can breathe in this pollen and live.

species.name: Shin
species.flavor: The side of its arms is shaped like a huge blade. It probably uses this to push the tall jungle grass aside as it walks.

species.name: SkunkRoller
species.flavor: This monster is the one that keeps the group together. If an argument crops up, it solves things right away. A dependable, leader type with lots of followers.

species.name: Shogun Mogi
species.flavor: Depend on it to guard the peace of the [[House of Treasure|capital]]. It plans on taking classes on the ancient art of {{wk|wikipedia|Onmyodo}} soon. It just might be able to use it someday.

species.name: Silver Face
species.flavor: It has escaped from its trainer because of its hard training.

species.name: Skeletant
species.flavor: An Antlan that was revived after its power ran out before achieving its goal. Even dead, it won’t stop. A sad hero...

species.name: Sieger
species.flavor: If the Sieger dives into the ocean, it’ll catch a fish bigger than it’s own body!

species.name: Shishi
species.flavor: It is said that anyone bitten by it will be lucky for a year.

species.name: Sketch
species.flavor: An enemy of Doodle who is constantly at odds with him.

species.name: Shimurug
species.flavor: This Dragon is said to be the guardian god of this region. It is strong against the cold with its thick fur, and its breath is a special flame called 'Ice Breath.'

species.name: Skull-Capped
species.flavor: It is scheming but not enough smart to deceive someone.

species.name: Skeleton
species.flavor: Its design is a reminder that death is always with us.

species.name: Skullwave
species.flavor: This monster is said to bear the soul of the legendary pirate Edgar. However, no one knows anything about this Edgar, so....

species.name: Shogun
species.flavor: This armor was discovered in an [[Eastern Continent|eastern]] country.

species.name: Siren
species.flavor: It has the ability to not only manipulate water but also wind.

species.name: Skull Gold
species.flavor: The strongest of all Jokers who wields a golden scythe. Its brilliance increases every time it drinks blood.

species.name: Shiisa
species.flavor: It's considered to be a Protector in some parts of the Southern countries. But it is too easily attached, hates to be on its own, and is a little fidgety.

species.name: Silver Piroro
species.flavor: It is said that the Silver Piroro has once been defeated by the Gold Piroro, even though it is well-known for being a monster genius in the art of performance.

species.name: Silver Suezo
species.flavor: This is also rare, for its body is the color silver.

species.name: Sky
species.flavor: His striking body pattern keeps him from going unseen.

species.name: Shrub
species.flavor: His body glows a green light at night. He loves insects.

species.name: Shironcho
species.flavor: Don't speak too loud when you see a Shironcho. It will go inside its shell and never come out.

species.name: Shiranui
species.flavor: Pixies who evolved uniquely on the [[Eastern Continent]]. They are talented monsters that wield first-class magic and martial arts skills.

species.name: Sodacchi
species.flavor: Some say it has Rhinoroller blood so it can move really fast, but few people have actually witnessed this. Apparently it doesn't expend energy unless it has to.

species.name: White Hound
species.flavor: This monster has pure white hair and much is made of it.

species.name: Spy Hare
species.flavor: Nobody has ever been able to find out much about it. It's usually looking around like it's nervous. Maybe it's backed by some kind of shady organization?

species.name: Sorcero
species.flavor: Unusual for the Chuparo breed, it's a nihilistic outlaw wearing a cloak. Since it's dressed all in black, it's weaker in strong sunlight.

species.name: Viper
species.flavor: It always holds its tongue out to cool its body temperature.

species.name: Stalgunner
species.flavor: It's a battle monster that has been modified so extensively that you could even say it's closer to a machine than a monster.

species.name: Sniper
species.flavor: This monster is feared as the dominator of the Mandy Desert.

species.name: Sloth Beetle
species.flavor: It resides in a high mountain region, that is covered in snow.

species.name: Stitch
species.flavor: It has a black-and-white striped body. If you stare at it for too long, your vision starts to spin as if you've been hypnotized.

species.name: Slash
species.flavor: This lizard has soft skin and razor-like claws.

species.name: Smiley
species.flavor: Appears lazy, but that is an act. It really has ability.

species.name: Spot
species.flavor: A keen sense of hearing enables him to dodge attacks.

species.name: Sraosha
species.flavor: A monster with beautiful wings on its flexible body. It is called

species.name: Springer
species.flavor: Its body shows a soft luster because of its Metalner blood.

species.name: Sneak Hopper
species.flavor: It is very self centered and it has a cunning character.

species.name: Snow Hopper
species.flavor: Snowboarding was created by copying the way this monster skis.

species.name: Stone Mask
species.flavor: A mighty warrior with devastating [[Power]].

species.name: Spirit Knight
species.flavor: Spirit Knight is the knight of all knights. The shining helmet is a symbol of this. It cleans it every day.

species.name: Smartie
species.flavor: It cracks nuts passed to it from [[Momo]] and makes very delicious cakes, which it shares with everyone. However, its true goal is to give everyone tooth decay!

species.name: Soul Reaper
species.flavor: He is a terrifying guy who believes that taking his opponent’s life is his mission, and carries it out properly.

species.name: Spearmint
species.flavor: The twisty thing on its head is not hair, but a shell. It is so fashionable that it goes underwater to put on these stylish things.

species.name: Sleeves
species.flavor: Another one who is very fashion-aware. Keep him thin.

species.name: Stinger (Dino Sub)
species.flavor: He can jump well and has an exceptional taste palette.

species.name: Soboros
species.flavor: His bulging eyes can search well, but they are weak.

species.name: Stoneface
species.flavor: A cute monster that lives inside a scary-looking rock. But it too is covered in rock, so no underestimations.

species.name: Sleepyhead
species.flavor: It spends most of its time in one place and hardly moves.

species.name: Snegurochka
species.flavor: A monster nicknamed the 'Granddaughter of Ice.' It possesses strong [[loyalty]] and high [[intelligence]]. Its skillful manipulation of trees and its bravery in overpowering enemies are a testament to its power.

species.name: Spooky
species.flavor: When a ghostly soul possessed a scarecrow, it is said that Spooky was born. It has a cheerful personality, and apparently has recently gotten into roulette.

species.name: Tanklon 2
species.flavor: A fearsome monster with a bomb onboard. Dreamed up by a mad scientist who pressed the button for detonation just before he died, but it still hasn't blown up yet.

species.name: Tanuta
species.flavor: It loves to sing with its striped tail wagging. It has a very playful personality and loves to travel, but it needs to be watched carefully if you don't want it to escape from your ranch.

species.name: Sueki Suezo
species.flavor: It is a man made monster, and its form is based on Suezo.

species.name: Suecho
species.flavor: Due to its upbringing, it is kind of spoiled. If it doesn't get its way, it throws a fit. Its butler always looks dumbfounded.

species.name: Sueko
species.flavor: This monster cares only for the way she looks.

species.name: Suzuricho
species.flavor: Always fascinated by bells, this monster finally turned into a bell itself. Often happy, sometimes sad, the beautiful sound washes away the heart's impurities.

species.name: Surfana
species.flavor: The Surfana just loves the ocean. You can often see it surfing in {{wk|wikipedia|California}} or {{wk|wikipedia|Hawaii}}. It says its goal this year is to visit {{wk|wikipedia|Australia}}.

species.name: Sumopion
species.flavor: It is strange looking, but it does practice hard every day.

species.name: Switch
species.flavor: This monster looks like a witch, though it has a large spoon instead of a cane. More dedicated to sweets research than magic, it's sometimes called a 'Sweets Witch.'

species.name: Stripe
species.flavor: Because of his stripe pattern, he's considered fashionable.

species.name: Sun
species.flavor: Its golden body is inhabited by the power of the sun. Its brightness is so intense that it even dazzles itself.

species.name: Tanklon
species.flavor: Enthusiastic fans, called the

species.name: Sunset Gali
species.flavor: This Gali, captivated by the sinking sunset, had its heart stolen by the moment. In order never to forget that feeling, it had it engraved into its very body.

species.name: Strawberry
species.flavor: Strawberry is a friendly and spoiled baby. Popular as a pet, its favorite food is the [[Strawberry (Item)|strawberry]], as you might have guessed.

species.name: Suntham
species.flavor: Suntham loves to swim. Its body isn't red because of Octopee's bloodline — instead, it's because it spends all day at the beach and gets sunburned.

species.name: Tainted Cat
species.flavor: It rejects everything in this world and lives alone.

species.name: Tank
species.flavor: His fancy clothes have long been a fashion trend.

species.name: SueAlien
species.flavor: There are rumors that SueAlien is not a creature of this planet. It is an agent of justice, although it lacks stamina.

species.name: Suezo-ish
species.flavor: Unlike other Suezo types, it's hard to to figure out where the eyeball is actually located on this one. Don't ask about that, or it'll get mad.

species.name: Tanuzo
species.flavor: It loves nuts and berries, and can run away quickly. Unlike other Suezos, this one is well-behaved.

species.name: Stripe Shell
species.flavor: This monster is very patient when fighting.

species.name: Striker
species.flavor: His sharp white claws make him dangerous. Easy to breed.

species.name: Swimmer
species.flavor: Training in the water will make the entire body toned up.

species.name: Strong Horn
species.flavor: Though it has a large horn, it hardly uses it in battle.

species.name: Talos
species.flavor: Talos is said to faithfully obey its master’s commands and protect a [[Shidira Rama|certain island]]. It is incredibly strong, but strangely enough, its only weakness is its heel.

species.name: Sweet Piroro
species.flavor: To think I'd meet a monster like this...how unfortunate I am, that no matter how many [[Mystery Disc|Disc Stone]]s I revive from now on, I'll never encounter a monster better than this one!...So sweet!

species.name: Tornado (Psiroller)
species.flavor: This is Tornado. He is the expert of great tackles! No one can approach his dumbbell trained body.

species.name: Titan
species.flavor: This mammoth monster loves to eat anything and everything.

species.name: Tihon
species.flavor: This icy Lamour is unsurpassed in pride. Characterized by napping as soon as it gets tired, it's one of the best healing monsters.

species.name: Tatoon-J
species.flavor: A billionaire spent lots of money to create this battle monster. Its flame tattoo symbolizes its furious fighting style.

species.name: Tetra
species.flavor: Long-ago people admired the Koropendora's teamwork and created the Tetra. We didn't know the Koropendora had been around so long until this Tetra was rediscovered.

species.name: Tomcat
species.flavor: It closes in with super speed and knocks out its opponent with a storm of punches! It holds the name 'Shootout King.'

species.name: Ticken
species.flavor: It is said that it contains the secret of the lost technology.

species.name: Tokunbokun
species.flavor: It used to have beautiful skin until it got a tan. Now it is so sad it just looks at itself in the water and cries.

species.name: Torridon
species.flavor: It was sunbathing at the beach in summer, but before it knew it, it had turned completely black. It got a bit too roasted and was pretty shocked about it.

species.name: Tender
species.flavor: A Henger created with the hopes that it wouldn't fight. As if that wish was understood, it started to love the forest and nature instead.

species.name: Toryo
species.flavor: He is very precise and does not like making mistakes. It attacks disruptive youths with its hammer at first sight.

species.name: Tombstone
species.flavor: This is a Joker monster with the strength of the Golem species.

species.name: TeeMaya
species.flavor: A hunter monster who is said to have eagle eyes with a night vision of a cat. Prey once targeted by it is ensure a slim chance of survival.

species.name: Tasman
species.flavor: This monster believes only in brute strength.

species.name: Tiger-ish
species.flavor: Tiger's blue mane now covers its entire body! Actually, this is the genuine fur color of the Tiger-ish, and many Tiger-type monsters are even said to admire it.

species.name: Tinkle Bell
species.flavor: Little and energetic Tinkle Bell loves cute clothes. If they get even a little dirty, it starts crying.

species.name: Time Noise
species.flavor: The secret goal that this one has is to obtain immortality.

species.name: Tigre
species.flavor: This monster is wild, as its look suggests. Many breeders fear this monster. But you seldom meet these, so don't worry.

species.name: Tortboy
species.flavor: This is the most relaxed of all Mews, and because of this many want it as a pet. It can move surprisingly fast sometimes, though.

species.name: Tidalle
species.flavor: When Tidalle swims, it causes tsunamis, so swimming is prohibited wherever it goes!

species.name: ThorHummer
species.flavor: Its Golden Arm attack splits the earth open and always defeats its enemies. Its one-hit knockout strategy is so tremendous that it needs no explanation!

species.name: Thrump
species.flavor: The soul of a hardworking person has possessed a clay doll. It gives a harsh punishment to those who don’t take their work seriously!

species.name: Tornado (Hare)
species.flavor: Likes the big moves. Able to charm unsuspecting people.

species.name: Techno Dino
species.flavor: Despite having a mechanical body, this species of Dino loves to remain active. But apparently, they sometimes get so engrossed that parts of their bodies pop out.

species.name: Therian
species.flavor: Therian is mischievous and cub-like, and perhaps because it is mixed with [[Tiger]], it is very loyal to its master. Those two monsters don't get along at all, so be careful when raising them together.

species.name: Torozo
species.flavor: A monster rumored to imitate the cute inhabitants of a faraway world. It is said that people have even witnessed it removing its ears and taking a short break, but Torozo refuses to comment on the matter.

species.name: Valkyrie
species.flavor: This fairy was born to fight. It's friendly, unless you make it upset. The blue eye can see the future while the red eye can see the past.

species.name: TraffiKoro
species.flavor: Usually, Color Pandora are just green. But if you put ketchup and mustard on its [[Saucer Stone]] and bake it, you get this monster. Nobody knew about this nifty trick!

species.name: Tri-Gai
species.flavor: Combining DNA, the PSM staff hoped to form a super-being to produce an entire issue unaided, as they played mini golf and drove go-carts. The experiment went really bad.

species.name: Uroboros
species.flavor: The wings of the Uroboros are extremely sharp and have excellent cutting power. Anything nearby won’t get away unscathed!

species.name: Unico
species.flavor: It is the most earnest monster in the [[Pixie]] species.

species.name: Truenos
species.flavor: Truenos is extremely jealous. If you pay too much attention to someone else, she’ll grow horns and attack you with her ray!

species.name: Ultrarl
species.flavor: It is said that this monster is a kind of hero of justice.

species.name: Trickster
species.flavor: It likes to play with its opponents, and eventually they realize they are moving at the Trickster’s pace. The birth of an unusual but cool hero!

species.name: Trojan
species.flavor: It has stone-like, hard skin and a stubborn character.

species.name: Trotter
species.flavor: It has an excellent reputation as an excellent runner.

species.name: Tumudillo
species.flavor: The TumuDillo has the Ripper's speed. If it takes off its shell, it's almost as fast! But moving fast gets it hungry, so it doesn't like to do it much.

species.name: Tram
species.flavor: This monster is covered by a house-like pattern.

species.name: Valentino
species.flavor: This lovable beast has wings but cannot fly.

species.name: Ultimate
species.flavor: This monster once ruled over the [[Land of Chaos|dark world]]. It's not in complete form now, as its body has been sealed, but it still has a firm command of the dark arts.

species.name: Undertaker
species.flavor: Appearing with a roaring sound, it wipes out everything it can see. To let you sleep peacefully, it'll finish you off in a single strike.

species.name: Uminaibi
species.flavor: A monster whose mysteries have just been revealed to be the sea god in ancient times. This so-called

species.name: Tricker
species.flavor: Contrary to its humorous appearance, its nature is rather evil.

species.name: Urara
species.flavor: A monster covered in smooth fur. Not only is it affectionate, it is very quick at learning tricks. But it is rather a spoilt baby, and tends to ignore people who it does not know.

species.name: Usazo
species.flavor: A timid prankster, Suezo likes to hide in the snow and scare people. Once, it even accidentally scared itself!

species.name: Valencie
species.flavor: Its pleasant scent is actually meant to keep enemies away. However, humans love the smell and adore it as a pet.

species.name: Two-Tone
species.flavor: Watch out for this monster and his dual personalities.

species.name: Trident
species.flavor: This monster pulls out all the punches to K.O. opponents.

species.name: Tsuboncho
species.flavor: Since they say that a Tsuboncho will grant three wishes to the Breeder that has been nice to it, many Breeders tend spoil their Tsubonchos rotten.

species.name: TropiMochi
species.flavor: A monster born in the southern lands. With a bright and positive attitude, it is constantly dancing, twisting its jelly like body. But it breaks down in tears sometimes thinking about father.

species.name: Typhon
species.flavor: It can proudly split any kind of fruit with the powerful flick of its finger. However, it breaks them into such tiny pieces that they aren't even worth eating any more.

species.name: Tyrant
species.flavor: The wings on its back are too small for it to fly.

species.name: Trickin
species.flavor: This ghostly spirit is influenced by Joker. Skilled at scheming, it seems to enjoy deceiving monsters and humans using various methods.

species.name: Vega
species.flavor: Vega is said to have been born when a dragon bathed in the holy light of a galaxy. As it flies across the sky like a shooting star to defeat its foes, people can't help but stare in awe.

species.name: Vesuvius
species.flavor: Its helmet has a curved Dragon figure on it.

species.name: Versailline
species.flavor: A beautiful female knight, beloved by all, that stands up for those who suffer. She proves that women, too, can fight courageously on the side of justice.

species.name: VenomHead
species.flavor: Its striking appearance and graceful movements caught people's attention, so they gave it the same name as a legendary scorpion goddess. It is a beautiful monster.

species.name: Vioscissor
species.flavor: It often appears in grasslands, where it neatly trims the grass. It's a very meticulous monster.

species.name: Venom Arrow
species.flavor: With a fierce temperament and claws filled with poison, it's the roughest, most unruly Arrow Head of them all.

species.name: Vermillion
species.flavor: A fast-moving ninja monster. It’ll start a fight with its burning fist!

species.name: War Baku
species.flavor: It functioned well as a shield in the ancient battle.

species.name: Vievle
species.flavor: The Vouivre is usually very calm in nature, but once angered, no one can stop it.

species.name: Vritra
species.flavor: It is said to have been born from vengeance and possesses power that can even surpass gods. However, it is deeply loyal, and once it acknowledges someone it will never betray them.

species.name: Wakken
species.flavor: Wakkungs knows the rings is fashionable. Although they say it change their patterns itself, no one has seen it in person.

species.name: Verde (Gali)
species.flavor: Verde is a magical being called 'God of the Desert' by some. However, its moody character sometimes causes it to create sand storms on a whim, to the annoyance of many.

species.name: Vulcan
species.flavor: They say this was the champion machine in the Henger fights long ago that made the Ancients go crazy.

species.name: Wabbit
species.flavor: Wabbit is full of charm and extremely sociable. It even appears regularly as a mascot in children’s programs on [[Age]]!

species.name: Venomous
species.flavor: It loves deceiving people above all else. Its skills are so refined that even those who are tricked can’t help but be impressed.

species.name: Verde (Golem)
species.flavor: Covered in a thin, emerald shell that is not durable.

species.name: VivaRoller
species.flavor: The sharp fangs are not used to fight, but to clean its rollers. This monster likes to keep things clean and tidy. It lives underwater.

species.name: Volcano
species.flavor: A Golem created while burning deep within molten lava. It unleashes devastating eruptions, making it nearly impossible to withstand its assaults.

species.name: Veldora
species.flavor: Despite its resemblance to another type of dragon known as the

species.name: White Mocchi
species.flavor: It has changed the color of its skin in order to be conspicuous.

species.name: XBakuBaku
species.flavor: Everyone's favorite,

species.name: Woodie
species.flavor: Woodie was sent here by a super weapon from the distant planet of [[Celfoan]]. It's a fairly timid monster, always worrying about burning itself when breathing fire.

species.name: White Suezo
species.flavor: It was raised very carefully because of its pure white body.

species.name: White Birch
species.flavor: It is more resistant to cold than other Mock monsters.

species.name: Winducken
species.flavor: This creature has no sense of direction, which led to the proverb

species.name: Wild West Naga
species.flavor: It wandered in aimlessly from the west. It's really popular with kids, but adults are puzzled by its looks and the odd way it's always saying, 'Oh dear...'

species.name: Wizring
species.flavor: The Wizring is a really hard worker, so it's always worn out and its clothes are all ragged. But it thinks it doesn't matter what it wears as long as it does its best.

species.name: Wolfie
species.flavor: The Wolfkin, who hides both wildness and kindness within. Its sharp, dignified expression is said to be irresistible, and its female fanbase is steadily growing!

species.name: Xtal Dragon
species.flavor: It has a beautiful body that sparkles brilliantly. It is said that all of its scales are made of crystal, making their value beyond measure.

species.name: Wyvern (Dragon)
species.flavor: Compared to other Dragons, it is notably more violent and aggressive. However, if it can be tamed, there is no greater ally.

species.name: Watermelony
species.flavor: On the beach, it is often mistaken for a watermelon.

species.name: Wondar
species.flavor: It always forgets what it is supposed to do.

species.name: Woody Hopper
species.flavor: It is covered with body hair that looks like bark at glance.

species.name: Whimfly
species.flavor: A model that was created by a machine-lover, into which a monster's soul will occasionally enter. Even though it’s just a toy, this feat is impressive.

species.name: Yabbic
species.flavor: A type of Henger designed to work in a factory and not in battle. Its hands were made into scissors for that very purpose.

species.name: Wood Knight
species.flavor: Poor knights made this armor out of trees in the ancient era.

species.name: Xenon-ish
species.flavor: Xenon-ish broke the seal with its own power before the curse was lifted. Due to this, it has emerged as an incomplete Xenon, with bits of the curse still in place.

species.name: Winglord
species.flavor: Winglord may look frightening at first glance, but is actually a talented warrior, fighting for peace and justice.

species.name: Wild Saurian
species.flavor: It is an active Zuum-type monster that has become wild.

species.name: Wood Saurian
species.flavor: It is cowardly and runs into the forest when it sees humans.

species.name: Warabi
species.flavor: Its skin is actually covered with sand. Because it carefully keeps itself covered, no one knows the real color of its skin.

species.name: Wood Golem
species.flavor: Unlike Mock, it rarely changes the expression on its face.

species.name: Wickerman
species.flavor: The Wickerman is devoted to its master and will agree to any command. However, please don’t ask it to do anything too unreasonable.

species.name: Witch
species.flavor: To brighten up the lively night, they wear special costumes. They invite anyone and everyone, and ask for sweets.

species.name: Wedding
species.flavor: An Undine dressed in a beautiful dress. Apparently, it longs for a human companion, and it can often be seen studying about housework and manners...

species.name: Yabusame
species.flavor: It is said that monsters struck by the demon-repelling arrows wielded by the Yabusame are left with a strange sense of solemnity.

species.name: Zanzo
species.flavor: The Zanzo travels so fast you can't even see it. All you can see is a big blur! Could that blur that just passed be a Zanzo, perhaps?

species.name: Yuma
species.flavor: This Lesione-type Henger was built by long-ago people for use on land as well as in the water. Because it was made for searching for things, it rarely gets lost.

species.name: Zabel

species.name: Zaratan
species.flavor: This creature can swim in the water as if it were flying, and its blue skin is rough like a [[shark]]'s. Don't touch it - you'll hurt your fingers.

species.name: Yuzuken
species.flavor: The most gentlemanly Ducken of them all. Afternoon tea, complete with a manly 'Self-destruct Attack' are simply the refined tastes of a true gentleman.

species.name: Zanken
species.flavor: Its wings are actually very sharp blades. However, they don’t seem to be very useful. How unfortunate.

species.name: Zorjil
species.flavor: It has a high IQ and it often gets lost in its thoughts.

species.name: YamiMaya
species.flavor: Also known as a transporter of death who is said to possess seven lives. One glare at the enemies with its glowing eyes could in an instance cripple their lives.

species.name: Zombie
species.flavor: A real wiseguy who loves to play dead and scare people.

species.name: Zilla King
species.flavor: It was awakened from an ancient sleep by a major earthquake.

species.name: Zan-ish
species.flavor: This monster is said to have been born from an afterimage of Zan moving at a super high speed. Many aspects of its existence are a mystery, and it is highly sought after by breeders.

species.name: Zebra Saurian
species.flavor: Its striped body is the least conspicuous in [[Papas|savanna region]].

species.name: Zeburo
species.flavor: It lives in the wild to entertain the wild monsters. But it used to suffer sudden attacks at times which prompted its body to develop camouflaging capabilities.

species.name: Yuppee
species.flavor: Yuppees are usually energetic, jumping, running, and rolling. But when they're tired and just standing still, they look just like snowmen.

species.name: Zaza
species.flavor: While you can often see Zaza having fun, rolling down the sand dunes, no one has ever seen Zaza climbing back up the dunes...

species.name: Yokozuna
species.flavor: Only those who have conquered the highest level of the foreign sport earn the title of Yokozuna. Once at the peak of both body and mind, it now appears to have reached the limits of its physical endurance.

species.name: Yashagami
species.flavor: This fiery and fierce Tiger breed with shining eyes has a strong fighting spirit that allows him to face any opponent.
